# Infectious diseases

The infectious disease landscape is ever-changing with outbreaks, mutations, emerging pathogens, and
growing resistances placing pressures on healthcare systems. Roche is determined to provide relief
and care.

[image of two gloved hands holding a laboratory sample]

## Challenge

Infectious diseases caused by viral and bacterial pathogens represent an ever-growing medical need
for millions of patients worldwide. Combining a rich legacy in infectious diseases with the latest
science and technology platforms, Roche focuses on the discovery and development of novel treatments
to address some of the world’s most pressing health challenges.

## Focus

Infectious diseases are becoming increasingly difficult to manage. While much healthcare effort is
devoted to preventing the spread of disease and associated treatments, less attention is paid to the
impact these infections have on the broader healthcare landscape.

Currently, Roche infectious diseases research and development is dedicated to finding effective
treatment for a number of life-threatening infections that include influenza and multi-drug
resistant bacteria. These diseases, for which there is often a high unmet medical need, affect
millions of people worldwide in wide degrees of severity. For this reason, and to ensure each
patient receives the most appropriate and effective care, Roche has adopted different strategies to
tackle the spread of these infectious diseases – from focusing efforts against multi-drug resistant
bacteria into developing treatments for the the top three Gram-negative bacteria identified by the
World Health Organization as number one Priority Pathogens, to continuing to innovate treatment
solutions to prevent as well as treat influenza, or combining therapies that pair direct-acting
antivirals with immune-enhancing molecules to treat viral hepatitis.

Viral hepatitis is a major public health threat and a leading cause of death worldwide.¹ An
estimated 354 million people are living with hepatitis B or C, leading to around 1.1 million deaths
per year.

### Pioneering in antibiotics

Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a major global health security challenge. Drug-resistant bacterial
infections cause deaths worldwide. The lack of effective antibiotics is threatening modern medicine,
making essential preventive and life-saving interventions increasingly difficult and allowing
hospital-acquired infections to spread.

# Breast Cancer

[A confident woman with natural curly hair wearing a pink turtleneck, looking thoughtfully at the
camera with a blurred green leafy background outdoors]

Breast cancer is a hugely complex disease. Our research and solutions aim to further our
understanding of breast cancer and improve outcomes for everyone affected by this disease.

## Challenge

There exists many types and subtypes of breast cancer, meaning every patient is different and thus
requires an individualised treatment approach.

Despite remarkable progress in this setting to date, some patients will see their disease return in
the long-term, which is why there is a critical need to continue to optimise early breast cancer
care and to do more to prevent the disease evolving to an advanced, incurable stage. By combining
pharmaceutical science, strong diagnostic, digital and genomic capabilities, we are able to innovate
and develop treatment options tailored to each individual’s needs. Our advanced diagnostic
solutions, and most notably the use of biomarker testing, bring us closer to fulfilling our
long-term ambition of offering patients personalised treatment approaches. It’s been an immense
challenge, but ongoing research efforts are finally bearing fruit for this challenging disease.

## Focus

We believe there is room for improving outcomes for people with breast cancer. Our focus lies in
identifying new targets, refining and exploring immunotherapy approaches, and investigating new
treatment combinations.

The advances in AI technology have revolutionized diagnostics, providing healthcare professionals
with more precise answers and allowing them to provide their patients with a wider array of
treatment options. Existing and new treatment options offer hope for those living with breast
cancer.

# Neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD)

[Decorative image]

Through medical innovation and partnerships, we are providing new options to people living with
neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) to help them retain as much independence as possible.

## Challenge

NMOSD is a rare, lifelong and debilitating autoimmune disease of the central nervous system,
primarily damaging the optic nerve(s) and spinal cord. It affects around 200,000 people worldwide
and is most common among women, affecting people in the prime of their lives, usually in their 30s
and 40s.

People with NMOSD experience unpredictable, severe relapses directly causing cumulative,
irreversible, neurological damage and disability. One relapse may lead to permanent blindness,
muscle weakness, paralysis and, in some cases, death. Before targeted diagnostic and treatment of
NMOSD, within five years 50% of individuals with NMOSD required a wheelchair and 62% of people with
NMOSD were functionally blind.

The right help and support can bring stability to people with NMOSD and ease the burden of the
disease. This includes enabling people with NMOSD to take control of how their condition is managed
and treated, based on their changing needs, to help them maintain a sense of independence.

## Focus

At Roche we believe greater awareness of NMOSD will benefit all those living with the condition; we
are committed to the community through our ongoing research.

Only recently have we seen a significant advancement of our understanding of NMOSD, developing
in-depth knowledge and new treatments. At Roche, we are committed to playing a significant part in
this advancement, taking an innovative approach to research and development. By working closely with
partners and patients, we can continue to transform the lives of those living with NMOSD. We never
stop following the science, ensuring we’re doing now what patients need next, to help preserve what
makes people who they are.

#### Transcript

[00:01]

Neuromyelitis Optica, or NMO, is a rare disease that affects up to 5 people in every 100,000. NMO
often affects people in the prime of their lives.

NMO can take away someone’s sight, mobility, and independence in an instant — and leave them feeling
exhausted. It can profoundly impact the person, their family, and every aspect of their life.

The threat of another relapse is a constant worry. Day-to-day living can become unpredictable, and
the future uncertain.

The right help and support can bring stability to those affected by NMO

[01:43]

and ease the burden of the disease. This enables people to look to the future and plan ahead.

People with NMO want to do as much as possible, for as long as possible — and plan for a future
beyond NMO.

### Voting via authorisations and instructions to the independent proxy

Shareholders may participate in the elections and votes exclusively by issuing authorisations and
instructions to the independent proxy, either in the form of written instructions sent by post or by
remote electronic voting (link below).

The written instructions form as well as the required login data for the remote electronic voting is
enclosed with the voting materials sent to the shareholders.

Shareholders may provide their written or electronic instructions (incl. the amendment of already
provided electronic instructions) by **Sunday, 13 March 2022, at 8.00 pm at the latest**. If a
shareholder issues instructions both by post and electronically, the instructions issued last will
be authoritative.

# Frequently asked questions

Welcome to the Roche frequently asked questions. Here you will find guidance on careers, products,
clinical trials, grants, partnerships and more. If your question is not answered here, our contact
channels are available to help you.

### Careers and employment

#### How can I work for Roche?

We welcome talented people who are inspired by our purpose and values. You can explore our current
opportunities on the [Careers page][102] , where you will find openings across a wide range of
functions, locations and experience levels.

#### I have applied for a role. When will I hear back?

Our recruitment teams review every application carefully. If your experience matches the
requirements of the role, a member of the team will contact you about next steps. As we receive many
applications, response times may vary.

#### I cannot find a suitable role at the moment. Can I stay connected with Roche?

Yes. You can join our [Talent Community][103] or set up a candidate profile on the [Careers
site][104] . This allows us to keep you informed when roles that match your skills and interests
become available.

### Grants, scholarships, donations and sponsorship

#### How can I request a grant, scholarship, donation or sponsorship?

Requests of this nature are reviewed according to [Roche’s global philanthropy criteria][105] .
Please visit our [Philanthropy Criteria and Requests page][106] to understand our principles,
eligibility requirements, and submission process.

#### What kinds of initiatives does Roche support?

We support projects that create sustainable, meaningful impact in areas such as education, community
health and social development. We do not support projects linked to political, religious or
commercial interests, and we cannot consider informal or unsigned requests.

### Products and medical information

#### Where can I find information about Roche products such as Accu-Chek®?

Information on Accu-Chek® and other Roche products is available on their dedicated websites. These
platforms offer guidance on product use, support services, and contact details.
* For Accu-Chek®, [find more information here.][107]
* For Roche Pharma products, [find more information here.][108]
* For Roche diagnostics products, [find more information here.][109]

#### I have questions about orders or invoices. Whom should I contact?

For questions relating to orders, invoicing or product supply, please contact the relevant local
Roche organisation. Contact details are available on [ our website’s Locations section.][110]

### Partnerships and business enquiries

#### I am interested in partnering with Roche as a distributor or business partner. How can I
#### proceed?

If you are seeking a partnership with our Pharmaceuticals or Diagnostics businesses, please [contact
us here.][111] Your enquiry will be directed to the appropriate Roche team for review.

If you are a supplier or wish to explore supplier opportunities with Roche, please visit
[suppliers.roche.com][112] for guidance on registration, requirements and our supplier standards.

### Clinical trials

#### Why does Roche conduct clinical trials?

[Clinical trials][113] are an integral part of the drug and diagnostic discovery and development
process. Before a new medicine or diagnostic test can be made available, evidence of its safety and
effectiveness must be provided by well-designed, well-controlled, and carefully monitored clinical
studies in patients who consent to participate.

#### How can I register for a clinical trial?

Up-to-date information on ongoing clinical trials, including how to take part, is available on our.
[patient-facing platform][114] This resource explains what participation involves and helps you find
trials that may be relevant to you.

### Corporate information and visits

#### Can I visit Roche offices, including the headquarters in Basel?

Yes. Information on visiting Roche in Basel, including available tours and how to book, is available
at [visit-roche.ch.][115] Please note that visits typically require advance booking due to security
and operational considerations.

#### I cannot find the information I am looking for. What should I do?

If your question is not covered here, please contact us through the general requests form available
on our website. Providing a brief description of your request helps us direct it to the most
appropriate team.

# Viral Hepatitis

[An older woman with short gray hair and glasses gazes thoughtfully out a window, wearing a
patterned black blouse, in a softly lit room.]

Viral hepatitis is a major public health threat and a leading cause of death worldwide.¹ An
estimated 354 million people are living with hepatitis B or C, leading to around 1.1 million deaths
per year. That means one person dies every 30 seconds as a result of hepatitis infection.²

At Roche, we believe that everyone deserves to get tested for hepatitis. We recognise that
accessible, reliable diagnostics are key to delivering on the WHO’s target of eliminating the virus
by 2030.

#### What is viral hepatitis?

Hepatitis is a term used to describe inflammation of the liver. It causes a range of health problems
and can be fatal.1 Although some forms of hepatitis can be caused by factors like autoimmune
diseases, obesity and alcohol, most cases are caused by one of five different hepatitis viruses:
types A, B, C, D and E.

All hepatitis viruses can cause acute infection and inflammation of the liver, but infection with
hepatitis B, C, D and E can also result in chronic hepatitis. This can lead to cirrhosis and
subsequently liver cancer.6

##### In a world where hepatitis testing and treatment have been made more accessible, what’s
##### stopping people from getting tested?

People with a history of drug and needle use, high risk sexual behaviors and prisoners are often at
higher risk for hepatitis. It can also be spread from infected pregnant women to their babies.
However, many are reluctant to get screened for fear of being labeled as someone “who deserves it”.
In many low and middle income countries (LMIC’s) testing and treatment remain beyond reach for most
people.

The campaign* Everyone deserves to get tested, *aims to destigmatise these groups among the general
public, and encourage people not to let silence come in the way of getting screened. No matter who
you are, or how you got it, everyone deserves to get tested for hepatitis.

## Challenge

Testing and treatment for hepatitis remain beyond reach for most patients. With 80% of hepatitis C
infections and 90% of hepatitis B infections going undiagnosed globally,3,4 the vast majority of
patients never receive a diagnosis.

Societal attitudes and taboos not only discourage individuals from seeking testing, but also
perpetuates a harmful culture of silence surrounding the disease. We believe that silence shouldn’t
prevent people from getting screened for hepatitis.

## Focus

Diagnostics are critical both to our ability to manage viral hepatitis, and to efforts to eliminate
it. An accurate diagnosis can allow patients to access appropriate and potentially curative
treatments, reducing the likelihood that they will go on to develop chronic disease, and minimising
the risk of serious complications like cancer.5 It also enables patients to take appropriate steps
to prevent onward transmission of the virus, reducing overall infections.

# Resources and Raw Materials

[she_resources_and_raw_materials]

#### Raw materials

In buying and using raw materials, we strive to conserve resources, avoid damage to the environment
and protect the health of our employees and the public. In line with the company’s commitment to
Sustainable Development and based on the Precautionary Principle it is Roche's responsibility and
intention to avoid any actual or potential unacceptable risk arising from the use of environmental
damaging compounds.

We also invite our suppliers to work jointly with us on improving supply chain sustainability. By
engaging proactively, we aim to promote innovation, manage performance and risk, ensure business
continuity and form emergency response plans. Roche’s suppliers are asked to commit to the
principles outlined in the Roche Supplier Code of Conduct.

[read more about the Roche SCOC suppliers][103]

#### Energy

For Roche, energy consumption is a material issue. As part of our commitment to a sustainable
development and the responsible use of resources, we continuously endeavour to cut energy
consumption while increasing the proportion of sustainable energy. Our strategy is to reduce our use
first, then look for ways to substitute fossil fuels with sustainable energy.

##### A systematic approach

We seek to improve energy efficiency throughout our global operations. This, in turn, will reduce
the environmental impact, the strain on the energy supply chain and costs. Our systematic approach
to energy management includes:
* constructing energy-efficient buildings
* retrofitting heating, cooling and air conditioning installations
* adjusting the range of acceptable temperatures in offices and other workplaces
* purchasing energy-efficient equipment, including hybrid and diesel-efficient cars
* changing work processes
* reviewing employees’ travel needs

[Our position on energy conservation][104]

#### Water

Roche is dependent on clean water for the production of pharmaceutical and diagnostic goods. We
support global efforts to protect and conserve water and to improve access to clean drinking water.
Our efforts to stabilise water consumption have resulted in our water use remaining relatively
unchanged over the past five years, despite the growth of the company.

We adopt water conservation and reduction programmes according to local conditions and needs. For
example, our Californian sites use drought resistant landscaping. We reduce water consumption at
other sites by:
* collecting and recycling water from cooling towers, creating a closed-loop system
* reusing cleaning water for next ‘first rinse’ and recycling used water
* reducing cooling requirements and improving cooling processes
* improving heat recovery resulting in lower cooling water demand

[Our position on water emissions][105]

# Lunsumio (mosunetuzumab) ▼

Lunsumio is a CD20xCD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibody. Lunsumio is approved in the EU for the
treatment of adult patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma who have received at
least two prior systemic therapies.

Lunsumio is a first-in-class fixed-duration CD20xCD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibody. Lunsumio
is approved in more than 50 countries, including the EU and the US, for the treatment of adult
patients with relapsed or refractory follicular lymphoma who have received at least two prior
systemic therapies.

# Code of conduct

Defining how we do business - every day, everywhere

[Close-up of a hand holding a pen over an open notebook, suggesting active note-taking. The
background is blurred, evoking focus and concentration.]

The Roche Group Code of Conduct states the expectations Roche has as an employer towards employees
and sets forth the standards for business behaviour that apply throughout the Roche Group.

### Fostering a compliance culture

All employees and all others acting on behalf of Roche must comply with the Roche Group Code of
Conduct, regardless of their location and the nature of their work. Also, following the “One Roche
Approach” principle, the set forth standards are equally binding for Group Functions, the
Pharmaceutical and the Diagnostics Division.

The Roche Group Code of Conduct is built on the Roche Values. The code contains guidance in the
areas of products and services, personal integrity, corporate integrity, employment, company assets,
responsible business and comprehensive compliance management. It also provides questions and
answers, examples and information on where to find more detailed guidance on the various topics.
Roche employees, as well as business critical business partners, are trained on the key compliance
principles by a global mandatory eLearning. The eLearning focuses on the following topics: bribery &
improper advantages, gifts & entertainment, conflict of interest, discrimination & harassment,
responsible use of social media & electronic communication tools, and business partners & supply
chain. All employees are required to complete this eLearning when they join Roche, as well as when
the Roche Group Code of Conduct gets updated every 5 years.

Roche is corporate member of numerous pharma and diagnostics/medical device associations and adheres
to the selfregulating Code of Conducts, including IFPMA, EFPIA, MedTech Europe, APACMed, MecoMed.
Also on local level, Roche Affiliates are often member of the local associations, as for example
interpharma, scienceindustries, Advamed US, Advamed China.

### Reporting Incidents

Anyone who becomes aware of a potential violation of the Roche Group Code of Conduct can and should
bring it to the attention of our Compliance experts.

The external [Roche Group speak-up channel][103] is available for everyone who is not a Roche
employee or contractor.

Roche employees and contractors can use the following reporting channels:
* The [Roche Group Code of Conduct Help & Advice Line][104] in case of compliance questions or
uncertainties and
* The [Roche Group speak-up channel,][105] to report in good faith a suspected violation, including
a person they believe has done, is doing or may be about to do something that violates the Roche
Group Code of Conduct or constitutes a workplace incident. The Roche Group speak-up channel is a
web-based service that allows for the confidential and anonymous reporting of compliance concerns,
using either written or voice formats. The speak-up channel operates in 104 countries and 42
languages, making it available worldwide

### Non-Retaliation Policy

Any employee who raises a compliance concern in good faith acts in the interest of Roche and
deserves acknowledgment. Roche does not tolerate any retaliation against an employee who raises a
compliance concern in good faith. Line Managers and/or employees who retaliate will be held
accountable. In case any employee deems that this principle is not adhered to, a complaint can and
should be raised to the Chief Compliance Officer.

Equally, Roche does not tolerate any abuse of the Roche speak-up channels.

### Process for adequate handling of non-compliant cases

Roche takes all non-compliance reports seriously and is fully committed to efficiently and timely
investigate them, to assess the facts and, if necessary, to take adequate corrective measures and
sanctions.

Our **Business Ethics Incident Management System (BEIMS)** enables our Management, the Chief
Compliance Officer and the Chief Group Audit and Risk Advisory Executive to capture, track and
monitor alleged violations, from initial reports through to resolution.

In 2025, 614 reports were received on the speak up channels. Of these, 242 were unfounded, 301 were
found. As a result 70 employment contracts and 2 agreements with business partners were terminated
on grounds of unethical behaviour, 123 led to a warning, 2 to bonus reduction. The rest of the
founded reports resulted in corrective measures.

In fiscal year 2025, the Roche Group's speak up line was managed by an external provider, offering
availability in 42 languages across 104 countries.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Roche is a global leader in pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, dedicated to advancing science to enhance patient care. The company offers a range of innovative products, including targeted therapies like Avastin and Herceptin for cancer treatment, as well as diagnostic solutions that support personalized healthcare for various medical conditions. With a focus on oncology and inflammatory diseases, Roche serves healthcare providers, oncologists, and patients worldwide.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Sanofi is a global healthcare company dedicated to transforming scientific innovations into therapeutic solutions that improve patient outcomes. With a strong focus on areas such as immunology, neurology, oncology, and rare diseases, Sanofi develops a diverse range of products, including vaccines and consumer healthcare solutions. The company is committed to sustainable and equitable access to healthcare, leveraging advanced technologies and partnerships to enhance drug discovery and patient engagement.

#### Careers

At Stryker, our employees use their unique strengths every day. We can help you discover, apply and
develop your own unique strengths and talents. We are firm believers that your individual strengths
are important - it's more about what you can do than what you have done. Find out more by visiting
our **[careers site][67].**

#### Employment verification

For U.S. employment verification, please contact The Work Number. Automated employment and income
verifications are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The Work Number Client Service Center is
available Monday – Friday; 7am – 8pm (CT) at 800 367 5690. To learn more,
visit [**theworknumber.com**][68]. If you encounter problems that The Work Number cannot address,
call us at +1 269 385 2600.

#### Ethics hotline

To report an ethics concern, contact our **[ethics hotline][69]**.

#### Investors

If you have investor relations questions, please view our investor contacts or call the corporate
office at +1 269 385 2600.

#### Product information

For information about our products or to place an order, please contact our divisions by using the
contact list below or the customer support centers tab. If you are uncertain which division to
contact, please call the corporate office at +1 269 385 2600.

#### Open source

We are fully committed to fulfilling its obligations per licensing requirements set forth by the
open source community. If you have questions regarding the use of Open Source, or wish to request a
copy of the Open Source software used in a product, please send an e-mail
to: **[OpenSourceRequest@stryker.com][70].**

#### Product report

We believe that quality comes first in all that we do. Please report any product issues so that we
can continue to monitor our products and services to ensure that they meet our high quality
standards.For specific products and services, you can get help by going to the customer support
center information below and click on the specific business group and location for contact
information. To report a product complaint or adverse event using our online
form, **[click here][71]**.

#### Media

We look forward to helping members of the media better understand our company. [**Contact us.**][72]

relevant_companies.company_summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is a leading provider of scientific instruments, reagents, and consumables, serving a diverse range of markets including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, and industrial applications. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, including antibodies, cell culture solutions, mass spectrometers, and lab services, aimed at accelerating scientific discovery and improving healthcare outcomes. With a commitment to innovation and customer support, Thermo Fisher empowers researchers and organizations to advance their work in life sciences and applied sciences.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific is a leading provider of scientific instruments, reagents, and consumables, serving a diverse range of markets including biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, clinical diagnostics, and industrial applications. The company offers a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, including antibodies, cell culture solutions, mass spectrometers, and lab services, aimed at accelerating scientific discovery and improving healthcare outcomes. With a commitment to innovation and customer support, Thermo Fisher empowers researchers and organizations to advance their work in life sciences and applied sciences.

##### CTV has a unique set of tools that make it easier to find the right clinical trial. Check out

[Woman searches for clinical trials]

##### Clinical trials offer access to the most modern medicines, vaccines, devices, and treatments.

##### [Find your site][15]

[Researcher with globe]

## What you can do using CTV

##### CTV has a unique set of tools that make it easier to find the right clinical trial. Check out
##### how each tool works to get the most out of CTV:

[

###### Trial notes

Save your thoughts about trials and come back to them later.

][16]
[

###### Follow trials

Track a trial's recruiting status and keep a list of trials in which you are interested.

][17]
[

###### Save trial search

Be notified when new trials are announced that meet your search criteria.

][18]
[

###### Contact sites

Sites contribute their trial contact directly in CTV so that you can get in contact with the right
person.

][19]
[

###### Search sites

Start with the site rather than the trial. Find a site and see all its trials.

][20]

# BMJ Open

is an online, open access journal, dedicated to publishing medical research from all disciplines and
therapeutic areas.

**Impact Factor:** 2.5
**Citescore:** 4.1
[All metrics >>][39]

The journal publishes all research study types, from protocols through phase I trials to
meta-analyses, including small, specialist studies, and negative studies. Publishing procedures are
built around fully open peer review and continuous publication, publishing research online as soon
as the article is ready.

*BMJ Open* aims to promote transparency in the publication process by publishing reviewer reports
and previous versions of manuscripts as pre-publication histories. Authors are asked to pay
article-publishing charges on acceptance; the ability to pay does not influence editorial decisions.

All papers are included in MEDLINE/PubMed and Science Citation Index Expanded (Web of Science).

[Current Issue][40][[Journal Current Issue]][41]

## Authors

BMJ Open accepts submissions on a range of article types, including original research, cohort
profiles and protocols.

The Author Information section provides specific article requirements to help you turn your research
into an article suitable for BMJ Open.

Information is also provided on [editorial policies][42] and [open access][43].

[Author information][44][Submit a paper][45]

**Track Your Order**

Keep track of your order’s progress by staying in touch with your writer or contacting our support

**Flexible Pricing**

Enjoy flexible pricing, we accept various payment modes. Become a returned customer and get enticing

#### > Order a custom paper [written from scratch][8]
#### > according to your requirements!

[Submit Your Essay Here][9]

**1. Submit your order details**

Issue all necessary instructions pertaining to your paper. This can include the number of pages, the
academic level and the urgency of your order. Provide any rubric needed by our professional writers.
Your account will be created automatically!

**2. Make your payment**

After filling out all the information, the price total is determined. We offer a variety of payment
modes from Paypal, VISA, MasterCard, MAESTRO among others. Your personal payment information is safe
and encrypted. An appropriate writer is assigned!

**3. The Writing Process**

We select the most suitable writer with regards to the academic level and the course. You can track
your order with our customer support team. Provide any left out resources (if any) for better

## We lead the NHS in England to deliver high quality services for all

If you are looking for information about health conditions and NHS services please visit
[NHS.uk][16].

[My Planned Care][17] gives you advice and support while you wait and helps you to prepare for your

Delivering continuous improvement across the NHS.

#### About Us

#### Welcome to MK Science Set Publishers: Your Gateway to Cutting-Edge Scientific Exploration

In the dynamic realm of scientific exploration, MK Science Set Publishers stands tall as a beacon of
innovation and excellence. As independent international scientific peer-reviewed clinical and
medical journal publishers, we take immense pride in our role as trailblazers, fostering a culture
of knowledge dissemination and collaboration on a global scale.

**Diversity Across Disciplines:** At MK Science Set Publishers, our commitment to advancing
scientific knowledge knows no bounds. With a focus on diverse subject areas such as Clinical,
Medical, Pharma, Biomedical, Life Sciences, Engineering, and Environmental studies, our online
journals encompass a vast array of content types. From in-depth research articles to
thought-provoking opinion pieces, our publications span the breadth and depth of scientific inquiry,
providing a comprehensive resource for scholars, researchers, and enthusiasts alike.

**Unrivaled Peer-Review Process:** What sets us apart as the best open access journal article
publishers is our unwavering dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality. Every piece
of content that graces our journals undergoes a meticulous peer-review process, ensuring that it not
only meets but exceeds the benchmarks of excellence. We take pride in being a trusted source for
rigorously reviewed research, review articles, case reports, and much more.



**Meet Our Team:** Behind the success of MK Science Set Publishers is a team of exceptional
individuals. Our community and advisory board members are not just professionals; they are
visionaries in their respective fields. With diverse expertise and a shared commitment to advancing
knowledge, our team plays a crucial role in discovering and developing new avenues for research and
development within our organization.

**A Vision for Knowledge Sharing:** As we journey forward, MK Science Set Publishers is guided by a
compelling vision — to develop an optimized knowledge-sharing platform and an enlightening
interactive network for researchers across the globe. This vision is not merely aspirational; it's a
strategic commitment to creating an environment where ideas flourish, collaborations thrive, and the
global scientific community evolves collectively.

**Optimized Knowledge-Sharing Platform:** Central to our vision is the creation of a cutting-edge
knowledge-sharing platform. This platform transcends the traditional boundaries of academic
publishing, incorporating innovative features designed to facilitate seamless collaboration,
interdisciplinary interactions, and real-time engagement. Researchers from diverse backgrounds
converge on our platform to contribute to and benefit from a collective pool of knowledge, thereby
propelling the wheels of scientific progress forward.

**Enlightening Interactive Network:** In our pursuit of excellence, MK Science Set Publishers
envisions a future where researchers worldwide are seamlessly connected in an enlightening
interactive network. Through our scientific publications and meetings, we are not only disseminating
knowledge but also fostering an environment where ideas transcend borders, collaboration knows no
limits, and the global scientific community thrives as one interconnected entity.

**Embarking on a Journey of Discovery:** As you explore the world of MK Science Set Publishers,
you're not just engaging with a publisher; you're embarking on a journey of discovery. We invite you
to join us as we redefine the landscape of knowledge dissemination, making science accessible,
collaborative, and impactful for all.

In every article we publish, every meeting we convene, and every interaction we facilitate, MK
Science Set Publishers is committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific integrity and

#### About Us

#### Welcome to MK Science Set Publishers: Your Gateway to Cutting-Edge Scientific Exploration

In the dynamic realm of scientific exploration, MK Science Set Publishers stands tall as a beacon of
innovation and excellence. As independent international scientific peer-reviewed clinical and
medical journal publishers, we take immense pride in our role as trailblazers, fostering a culture
of knowledge dissemination and collaboration on a global scale.

**Diversity Across Disciplines:** At MK Science Set Publishers, our commitment to advancing
scientific knowledge knows no bounds. With a focus on diverse subject areas such as Clinical,
Medical, Pharma, Biomedical, Life Sciences, Engineering, and Environmental studies, our online
journals encompass a vast array of content types. From in-depth research articles to
thought-provoking opinion pieces, our publications span the breadth and depth of scientific inquiry,
providing a comprehensive resource for scholars, researchers, and enthusiasts alike.

**Unrivaled Peer-Review Process:** What sets us apart as the best open access journal article
publishers is our unwavering dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality. Every piece
of content that graces our journals undergoes a meticulous peer-review process, ensuring that it not
only meets but exceeds the benchmarks of excellence. We take pride in being a trusted source for
rigorously reviewed research, review articles, case reports, and much more.



**Meet Our Team:** Behind the success of MK Science Set Publishers is a team of exceptional
individuals. Our community and advisory board members are not just professionals; they are
visionaries in their respective fields. With diverse expertise and a shared commitment to advancing
knowledge, our team plays a crucial role in discovering and developing new avenues for research and
development within our organization.

**A Vision for Knowledge Sharing:** As we journey forward, MK Science Set Publishers is guided by a
compelling vision — to develop an optimized knowledge-sharing platform and an enlightening
interactive network for researchers across the globe. This vision is not merely aspirational; it's a
strategic commitment to creating an environment where ideas flourish, collaborations thrive, and the
global scientific community evolves collectively.

**Optimized Knowledge-Sharing Platform:** Central to our vision is the creation of a cutting-edge
knowledge-sharing platform. This platform transcends the traditional boundaries of academic
publishing, incorporating innovative features designed to facilitate seamless collaboration,
interdisciplinary interactions, and real-time engagement. Researchers from diverse backgrounds
converge on our platform to contribute to and benefit from a collective pool of knowledge, thereby
propelling the wheels of scientific progress forward.

**Enlightening Interactive Network:** In our pursuit of excellence, MK Science Set Publishers
envisions a future where researchers worldwide are seamlessly connected in an enlightening
interactive network. Through our scientific publications and meetings, we are not only disseminating
knowledge but also fostering an environment where ideas transcend borders, collaboration knows no
limits, and the global scientific community thrives as one interconnected entity.

**Embarking on a Journey of Discovery:** As you explore the world of MK Science Set Publishers,
you're not just engaging with a publisher; you're embarking on a journey of discovery. We invite you
to join us as we redefine the landscape of knowledge dissemination, making science accessible,
collaborative, and impactful for all.

In every article we publish, every meeting we convene, and every interaction we facilitate, MK
Science Set Publishers is committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific integrity and
contributing to the advancement of knowledge that benefits humanity. Join us in this exciting
endeavor, where innovation meets excellence in scientific publishing.

## Award-Winning Technology

## Our Products

At Recovery Force Health, our mission is to be a leader in providing innovative devices and digital
health solutions that alleviate unnecessary barriers for healthcare professionals in the hospital
and at home to improve patient outcomes.

## MAC™

The **world’s first** wearable therapeutic compression device that also measures and displays
real-time patient compliance (wear time) and mobility data.

[Learn more][18]

## ELEVATE™

Designed to effectively offload the sacrum and seamlessly contour the body to enhance patient
comfort and compliance.

[Learn more][19]

## HeelP.O.D.™

Effectively offloads or “floats” the foot and provides visual assurance of offloading with immersion
& envelopment technology.

[Learn more][20]

## Impacting Patients – *It’s in our DNA*

## Patients Impacted

## MAC Legs Served

# The Importance of Early Mobilization

Contrary to popular thought processes, mobility is more than just ambulating. Mobilization can also
mean periodic changes in position, such as turning the patient, sitting in bed, dangling at the side
of the bed, getting to the chair, and ambulation.

Studies have shown that implementing **early progressive mobilization** is associated with improved
functional outcomes, reduced hospital costs, and decreased length of stay.

Since 2018, we’ve collaborated with Mayo Clinic to develop a novel mechanism for enhancing blood
flow and optimizing clinical workflow.

[Learn more][21]

# Development of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a clinical stage biotech company based in Sweden,
dedicated to advancing the field of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics. Our mission is to establish a
world-leading company in RNA research and development, ultimately making a positive impact on
patients worldwide.

[ Learn more ][23]
[ Partnering opportunities ][24]

### About Ribocure

Ribocure has established an exceptional setup known as “from bench-to-bed” on the fifth and sixth
floor in the GoCo Clinic building. This setup encompasses an R&D department, an in vitro human cell
lab, and the Ribocure Clinic which serves as a specialized unit for Phase 2 clinical trials.

The Ribocure Clinic is dedicated to ensuring top-notch quality in conducting proof-of-principle and
concept trials within our expertise areas, while also featuring a functional imaging core lab
capacity.

[ Read more ][25]
[Ribocure]

### Partnering opportunities

Ribocure is open to partnering opportunities. If you think there are prerequisites for a fruitful
collaboration, please contact our Vice President of Business Development for a discussion.

John Taylor, VP Business Development

[john.taylor@ribocure.com][26]

[career opportunities]

## Oligonucleotide therapeutics for your wellbeing

Ribocure’s main emphasis lies in addressing the significant unmet medical requirements in rare
diseases associated with cardiovascular, renal, and oncology therapeutic areas. The company is fully
committed to the exploration and advancement of first- and best-in-class drug assets, aiming to
pioneer the development of groundbreaking treatments using innovative oligonucleotide technologies.
As a subsidiary of Ribo Life Science Co., Ltd., Ribocure leverages the advantages of a vertically
integrated oligonucleotide research platform while incorporating their exceptional translational and
clinical operational expertise within the organization.

[ Read more ][27]

### Building a world-leading company in Sweden

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a newly established Swedish biotech company that
specializes in the cutting-edge development of RNA therapeutics. We aspire to forge a world-leading
company in RNA therapeutics research and development here in Sweden, with the aim of making a
positive impact on patients across the globe.

# Development of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a clinical stage biotech company based in Sweden,
dedicated to advancing the field of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics. Our mission is to establish a
world-leading company in RNA research and development, ultimately making a positive impact on
patients worldwide.

[ Learn more ][23]
[ Partnering opportunities ][24]

### About Ribocure

Ribocure has established an exceptional setup known as “from bench-to-bed” on the fifth and sixth
floor in the GoCo Clinic building. This setup encompasses an R&D department, an in vitro human cell
lab, and the Ribocure Clinic which serves as a specialized unit for Phase 2 clinical trials.

The Ribocure Clinic is dedicated to ensuring top-notch quality in conducting proof-of-principle and
concept trials within our expertise areas, while also featuring a functional imaging core lab
capacity.

[ Read more ][25]

### Partnering opportunities

Ribocure is open to partnering opportunities. If you think there are prerequisites for a fruitful
collaboration, please contact our Vice President of Business Development for a discussion.

John Taylor, VP Business Development

[john.taylor@ribocure.com][26]

## Oligonucleotide therapeutics for your wellbeing

Ribocure’s main emphasis lies in addressing the significant unmet medical requirements in rare
diseases associated with cardiovascular, renal, and oncology therapeutic areas. The company is fully
committed to the exploration and advancement of first- and best-in-class drug assets, aiming to
pioneer the development of groundbreaking treatments using innovative oligonucleotide technologies.
As a subsidiary of Ribo Life Science Co., Ltd., Ribocure leverages the advantages of a vertically
integrated oligonucleotide research platform while incorporating their exceptional translational and
clinical operational expertise within the organization.

[ Read more ][27]

### Building a world-leading company in Sweden

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a newly established Swedish biotech company that
specializes in the cutting-edge development of RNA therapeutics. We aspire to forge a world-leading
company in RNA therapeutics research and development here in Sweden, with the aim of making a
positive impact on patients across the globe.

# AIROS Medical brings together medical device veterans dedicated to advancing compression therapy
# across lymphatic, venous, and arterial care.

We develop solutions for individuals living with lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency, and
swelling related to cancer treatment, as well as arterial conditions such as Peripheral Arterial
Disease (PAD), Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI), and diabetic foot complications.

[ Continue Reading][32]

[Solutions Overview][Solutions Overview]

## Patient-Oriented Solutions

**Our medical technology provides solutions** for patients suffering from these conditions,
clinicians trying to treat these complications, and DME suppliers whose purpose is to provide
effective treatment inside the home.

**Our approach to product design **is to utilize high-end technology across our entire line of
devices and garments so that patients of all ages and financial backgrounds can receive proper
therapy immediately.

[Patient][Patient]

## Solutions for Patients

If you have been diagnosed with primary or secondary lymphedema, lymphedema as a result of cancer
treatment, or Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), you may be prescribed a Sequential Compression
Device (SCD) to be used at home.

For individuals living with Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia
(CLTI), your provider may recommend an arterial intermittent pneumatic compression (IPC) device to
support circulation and promote healing. This type of therapy delivers rapid, high-pressure
compression to help increase blood flow, improve walking tolerance, reduce rest pain, and assist in
wound healing — offering a non-invasive option for patients who are not candidates for surgical
intervention or who need additional support during recovery.

[Learn More][33]

[Solutions for Patients][Solutions for Patients]
[Solutions for Medical Professionals][Solutions for Medical Professionals]

Our team at AIROS Medical is comprised of healthcare industry veterans who have developed
relationships with physicians and clinicians in various specialties.

[Learn More][34]

[Solutions for Medical Professionals][Solutions for Medical Professionals]
[Solutions for DMEs][Solutions for DMEs]

## Solutions for DMEs

From billing experts and insurance veterans to product, sales, and marketing support, our team
prides itself on developing long-lasting, mutually-beneficial relationships with DME suppliers. Our
focus is in helping our DME partners compete and learn how to help treat patients for years to come.

[Learn More][35]

# Driving Compliance and Positive Patient Outcomes

Our team at AIROS Medical is comprised of healthcare industry veterans and experts who are dedicated
to helping patients live better while reducing headaches for providers.

[ Continue Reading][33]

## Developing relationships with physicians and clinicians

We have worked with vascular surgeons, podiatrists, artery and vein specialists, cardiologists,
physical therapists, lymphedema therapists, wound care professionals, and others.

We understand that when it comes to medical devices and treatment in general, patient compliance is
vital to success and outcomes. Our goal is ultimately to help patients suffering from chronic
diseases live a better quality of life.

[Solutions for Medical Professionals][Solutions for Medical Professionals]
[Solution Texture][Solution Texture]
[Solutions for Medical Professionals][Solutions for Medical Professionals]

We value our relationships with **healthcare providers** and our ability to help various types of
**physicians** and **medical personnel** treat chronic conditions.

### Conditions Treated

We specialize in designing, engineering, and manufacturing compression therapy devices that support
patients living with lymphedema, Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), and other venous complications.
This includes lymphedema that many breast cancer patients must manage following surgery, radiation,
or other treatments.

In addition to our lymphatic and venous solutions, we also provide compression technology to help
support patients with Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) and Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI)
who may require increased arterial blood flow to aid wound healing, reduce rest pain, or improve
mobility.

Our pneumatic compression devices, upper-body garments, lower-extremity garments, lower-truncal
garments, and arterial compression system are relied upon daily by physicians, lymphedema
therapists, vascular specialists, podiatrists, and other healthcare professionals.

We value our relationships with the providers who trust our technology to help patients manage
chronic conditions safely and effectively.

### At-Home Therapy

Our line of Sequential Compression Devices—also known as arm and leg compression pumps—is primarily
used at home to support long-term management of lymphedema and venous disorders. Once prescribed,
patients work with a DME supplier who provides the device, garments, and education needed to begin
therapy safely and confidently.

For patients with arterial insufficiency, our ARTAIRA™ arterial compression device offers an at-home
option designed to support blood flow and wound healing through high-pressure intermittent pneumatic
compression (IPC). Like our lymphatic pumps, ARTAIRA is delivered through trusted DME partners who
ensure proper setup and patient training.

We work closely with our DME network to make sure patients receive the correct therapy based on
their clinician’s prescription—whether managing lymphatic, venous, or arterial conditions.

### Intuitive Device Design

Every device in our portfolio is built with patient ease-of-use in mind. Our compression systems
feature intuitive controls, clear displays, and simple operation so patients can begin therapy with
confidence.

Clinicians and DME suppliers can easily set prescribed pressures, treatment modes, and cycle times.
Whether using one of our lymphatic pumps or the ARTAIRA arterial device, patients can begin therapy
with just a few button presses, making it easier to stay consistent with their prescribed care.

### Usage Data Feature

We also included a Usage Data feature that tracks how often patients utilize the devices. Viewing
this data can help chart or revise patient treatment plans and promote compliance.

Learn more about how our [products][34] work, including videos that provide operational tutorials.

Please [contact us][35] immediately if you have any questions about our devices, the conditions we
treat, or any other matters.

# Working to Help Patients Feel Better & Live Healthier

AIROS Medical designs, manufactures, and distributes compression pumps to help patients who are
dealing with PAD, arterial disease, primary or secondary lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency
(CVI), and other disorders.

[ Continue Reading][33]

## Providing compression therapy treatments to help people like you feel and live better.

If you have been diagnosed with primary or secondary lymphedema, lymphedema related to cancer
treatment, Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), or arterial conditions such as Peripheral Arterial
Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI), you may be prescribed a compression
therapy device to support your care at home.

Compression therapy can help patients experiencing swelling, venous ulcers, slow-healing wounds,
poor circulation, or discomfort related to venous or arterial insufficiency.

AIROS Medical designs, engineers, and manufactures a full portfolio of therapy solutions — including
Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) for lymphedema and venous complications and the ARTAIRA™
Arterial Compression Device for PAD and CLTI.

For more than 20 years, our team has worked alongside podiatrists, vascular surgeons, wound care
specialists, and certified lymphedema therapists to ensure patients receive safe, effective, and
clinically supported compression therapy. Our mission is simple: help people move, heal, and live
better through proven, accessible technology.

AIROS Medical does not dispense devices directly to patients. Instead, we partner with Durable
Medical Equipment (DME) suppliers who deliver our pumps and garments, provide education, and ensure
patients receive the therapy prescribed by their clinicians.

[Solutions for Patients][Solutions for Patients]
[Solution Texture][Solution Texture]
[Patient][Patient]

We understand that when it comes to medical devices, and treatment in general, **patient compliance
is vital to success and outcomes**. Our goal is ultimately to help patients suffering from chronic
diseases **live a better quality of life**.

### Conditions Treated

Our compression therapy devices provide treatment for the following conditions:
* PAD
* Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia
* Diabetic foot ulcers
* Gangrene
* Arterial foot ulcers
* Lymphedema
* Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI)
* Venous Stasis Ulcers
* Other Venous Insufficiencies
* Peripheral Edema

Learn more about the specific [conditions][34] AIROS Medical specializes in treating.

### At-Home Therapy

Our suite of compression therapy devices supports both lymphatic and arterial patient
needs—providing effective home-based treatment that helps patients stay consistent with their care.

For lymphatic and venous patients, our Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) – also known as arm and
leg compression pumps – deliver gentle, gradient pressure designed to help reduce swelling and
improve fluid movement.

For arterial patients, our ARTAIRA™ Arterial Compression Device delivers high-pressure, intermittent
pneumatic compression (IPC) designed to help increase arterial blood flow, support wound healing,
and reduce ischemic discomfort.

Once prescribed either a lymphatic or arterial device, patients are connected with a knowledgeable
DME supplier who guides them through setup and use in the comfort of their homes.

We ensure that each partner in our DME network is well-trained in compression therapy and familiar
with our full portfolio so that clinicians and patients receive the correct therapy for their
condition.

### Intuitive Device Design

Whether supporting lymphatic, venous, or arterial conditions, we design all AIROS Medical devices to
be intuitive, user-friendly, and easy to operate.

DME suppliers and healthcare professionals can quickly set the appropriate pressures, modes, and
cycle times for each device. Patients can begin therapy with just a few button presses—keeping
treatment simple, consistent, and accessible regardless of the condition being managed.

From gentle gradient compression for lymphedema and CVI, to rapid, high-pressure cycles for
improving arterial flow with ARTAIRA™, our entire portfolio was created to support life in motion
and help patients stay consistent with their therapy at home.

### Insurance

Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) — also referred to as Pneumatic Compression Devices (PCDs) —
are commonly reimbursed by Medicare and most private insurance plans. These devices are used to help
manage lymphedema, Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), and other swelling-related conditions.

For patients with Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI),
arterial compression therapy may also be covered when medically necessary. Coverage varies depending
on diagnosis, clinical documentation, and insurer requirements.

Because every patient’s situation is unique, it’s important to check directly with your Medicare
plan or private insurance carrier to understand what equipment and services are included in your
benefits.

# Dedicated to DME Success

Our team at AIROS Medical has extensive experience in the DME industry. We understand both the
opportunities and challenges you have as a medical equipment supplier.

[ Continue Reading][33]

## Helping make DMEs competitive and successful

AIROS Medical is dedicated to providing advanced, high-quality devices and outstanding
communication, service, and support to help make DMEs competitive and successful.

From billing experts and insurance veterans to product, sales, and marketing support, our team
prides itself on developing long-lasting, mutually beneficial relationships with DME suppliers. Our
focus is on helping our DME partners compete and learn how to help treat patients for years to come.

[Solutions for DMEs][Solutions for DMEs]
[Solution Texture][Solution Texture]
[Solutions for DMEs][Solutions for DMEs]

From billing experts and insurance veterans to product, sales, and marketing support, our team
prides itself on **developing long-lasting, mutually-beneficial relationships with DME suppliers**.

### Referral Sources

The following types of healthcare professionals utilize our devices and garments.
* Podiatrists
* Wound Care Professionals
* Vascular Surgeons
* Physical Therapists
* Family/General Practice
* Orthopedic Surgeons
* Cardiologists
* Oncologists
* Lymphedema Therapists

### Products

Our goal with product design has always been to offer high-end devices and garments at an affordable
price for DMEs so that they can remain competitive and support the patients and clinicians they
serve. We have designed and manufactured various Sequential Compression Devices, drawing from
decades in the pneumatic compression space. We launched in 2018 with the AIROS 6 and the AIROS 8,
and have continued to innovate and bring new devices with more features to the market.

The [AIROS 6][34] is a 6-chamber compression pump utilized to treat lymphedema, venous
insufficiencies in the lower limbs, and other complications. The AIROS 6P operates the same way, but
adds the Peristaltic operating mode that is preferred by many lymphedema therapists for upper
extremity treatment.

The [AIROS 8][35] is an 8-chamber compression pump that has a higher reimbursement, namely because
of added features and the ability to change pressures in each garment chamber. The AIROS 8P also
features the Peristaltic Mode, and like the AIROS 6P has a larger pump and 100-240 VAC electrical
rating for use anywhere in the world.

All of our devices are used with our full line of [compression garments][36], available in dozens of
sizes and configurations. The AIROS 6P and AIROS 8P also work with our [truncal compression
garments][37], which are pants-like models that treat abdominal and pelvic swelling.

### Billing

AIROS Medical’s team includes DME industry veterans well-versed in Medicare, Medicaid, and private
insurance regulations around our various products.

We provide knowledge to our DME partners to ensure that compression pumps get billed correctly, and
that the correct paperwork gets completed.

DMEs leverage our expertise in the area of billing and insurance every day to help them be compliant
and successful.

### Support

Learn more about our [products][38], including videos providing tutorials on how our devices and
garments work.

DMEs that work with AIROS Medical receive a support packet with various resources to help them.

If you have any questions or are interested in providing AIROS Medical’s product line,
please [contact us][39] immediately.

###### Our History

### Founded on decades of experience

AIROS Medical was founded in 2016 outside of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania by medical device experts
with decades of experience in Durable Medical Equipment (DME).

Our leadership team is comprised of DME owners who had marketed and sold pneumatic compression
devices from various manufacturers for years. Their experience working with lymphedema therapists,
vascular surgeons, and other medical professionals, coupled with acquired billing and insurance
expertise, led them to consider creating their own devices.

After meeting with certified lymphedema therapists (CLTs), physical therapists, specialty
physicians, and other DME providers, the team formed AIROS Medical with the goal of engineering and
manufacturing devices and garments with the features that patients and clinicians prefer at a price
point that would allow DMEs to provide these products to as many patients as possible.

Today, medical professionals, patients, and DMEs across the United States rely on AIROS Medical’s
product line to efficiently and effectively treat lymphatic and venous disorders.

###### Outside In – Clinician value proposition

For Clinicians

For the clinicians treating lymphatic and venous disorders, to maintain results of in-person therapy
when the patient returns home, AIROS Medical provides a user-friendly, affordable compression
therapy device designed to increase compliance so patients can reduce swelling and pain, allowing
them to live healthier and more active lifestyles.

For Patients

For patients with lower and upper extremity lymphatic and vascular conditions with lack of mobility
and flexibility, Airos Medical provides an in-home state of the art compression device that delivers
relief from edema while providing improved circulation, mobility and skin integrity allowing for a
much-improved quality of life.

## John Evans, DPM, DABFAS, FACFAS

#### Medical Advisor

## Gerry Makoid

#### President and CEO

Gerry has been the President and CEO of AIROS Medical since its inception in 2016. Prior to
co-founding AIROS, Gerry has worked for sales teams in the Philadelphia area primarily focused on
regional territory development and sales goals in the mid-Atlantic region. Gerry finds the most joy
in his work with AIROS seeing the positive effect that our devices have on a patients’ quality of
life.

## Michael Allerton

#### VP of Sales

Michael comes to AIROS with years of experience in medical device sales, new business development,
and sales operations. He joined the team as Vice President of Sales and is excited to see how the
AIROS devices can help alleviate and manage symptoms of lymphedema and venous disorders.

## Darren Behuniak

#### Chief Operating Officer

Darren comes to AIROS with over a decade of experience in corporate marketing and start-up
environments. Throughout his career, he has helped a variety of organizations generate leads,
increase sales, and develop a strong online presence. At AIROS, he is responsible for driving
multiple FDA 510k clearances of medical technology and helping launch the company as a co-founder.

## Chris Allerton

#### VP of Business Development

Chris comes to AIROS with years of experience sourcing new business opportunities in the medical
device industry. Chris has been the VP of Business Development here at AIROS since 2018 and finds
the most reward in his work when he hears about the successes that the patients have had using our
devices to manage their symptoms.

## Adrien MacKenzie

#### Clinical Advisor

Adie MacKenzie is a national board-certified health and wellness coach and a Certified Lymphedema
Therapist. She has over 40 years of experience in manual therapy, including medical massage and
physical therapy. She currently treats lymphedema patients and people with chronic pain and chronic
illnesses as part of her private practice.

## Kelly Sturm

#### Clinical Advisor

Kelly is a physical therapist, Certified Lymphedema Therapist, and one of the first national
board-certified oncology clinical specialists in the United States. She serves as an instructor at
Concordia University’s Physical Therapy Program and a guest speaker at various conferences,
programs, and community groups. She also owns Cancer Rehab PT, LLC, an educational content company
focused on educating individuals interested in lymphedema, oncology rehabilitation, and physical
therapy.

## Betty Westbrook

#### Clinical Advisor

Betty Westbrook is a Physical Therapist Assistant certified in advanced lymphedema management.
Through her passion to educate others about Lymphedema she created Lymphedema Podcast, and this
introduced her to many more opportunities to advocate for the underserved Lymphedema community. In
2019 Betty created the first summer camp for children with Lymphedema in the United States. Camp
Watchme is a time for children with Lymphedema and their parents to immerse themselves in a
community of others who understand exactly what they are going through. Advocacy, education, and
community are three things Betty values most as a voice for the Lymphedema community.

## John Evans, DPM, DABFAS, FACFAS

#### Medical Advisor

Dr. Evans received his DPM from the Temple University College of Podiatric Medicine and has a BS in
Pharmacy from the University of Connecticut. He is board-certified by the American Board of Foot and
Ankle Surgery (Foot and Ankle) and is Chief of Podiatry at Corewell Health (Beaumont) Medical Center
in Dearborn, Michigan.

He has served as Chair of the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA) Health Policy and
Practice Committee and as a Medicare Carrier Advisory Committee (CAC) representative for over 20
years and was the 2018 recipient of the APMA Award of Excellence. He served as the Podiatric
representative to the PAD Guidelines Writing Committee of the American Heart Assn. and American
College of Cardiology which were published in 2024 and serves as the Podiatric representative of
APMA to the AHA PVD Leadership Council. He is active with the American Board of Foot and Ankle
Surgery, having served on multiple committees including their Board of Directors for eight years,
and is the immediate Past-Chair of their Communications Committee. He is active with the American
Limb Preservation Society on the Health Equity and Advocacy Committee as Co-Chair of the Research
and Data Analysis Sub-Committee, the CLI Global Society, and as faculty for the New Cardiovascular
Horizons organization, Desert Foot, and Goldfarb Foundation.

Dr. Evans is a nationally recognized speaker on a variety of topics including Peripheral Arterial
Disease, the Diabetic Foot, Limb Salvage and Preservation, Physician Burnout, Dealing with the
Difficult Patient, and Mindfulness in Medicine. Dr. Evans is in private practice in southeast
Michigan.

# AIROS Medical brings together medical device veterans dedicated to advancing compression therapy
# across lymphatic, venous, and arterial care.

We develop solutions for individuals living with lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency, and
swelling related to cancer treatment, as well as arterial conditions such as Peripheral Arterial
Disease (PAD), Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI), and diabetic foot complications.

[Solutions Overview][Solutions Overview]

## Patient-Oriented Solutions

**Our medical technology provides solutions** for patients suffering from these conditions,
clinicians trying to treat these complications, and DME suppliers whose purpose is to provide
effective treatment inside the home.

**Our approach to product design **is to utilize high-end technology across our entire line of
devices and garments so that patients of all ages and financial backgrounds can receive proper
therapy immediately.

[Patient][Patient]

## Solutions for Patients

If you have been diagnosed with primary or secondary lymphedema, lymphedema as a result of cancer
treatment, or Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), you may be prescribed a Sequential Compression
Device (SCD) to be used at home.

For individuals living with Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia
(CLTI), your provider may recommend an arterial intermittent pneumatic compression (IPC) device to
support circulation and promote healing. This type of therapy delivers rapid, high-pressure
compression to help increase blood flow, improve walking tolerance, reduce rest pain, and assist in
wound healing — offering a non-invasive option for patients who are not candidates for surgical
intervention or who need additional support during recovery.

# Working to Help Patients Feel Better & Live Healthier

AIROS Medical designs, manufactures, and distributes compression pumps to help patients who are
dealing with PAD, arterial disease, primary or secondary lymphedema, chronic venous insufficiency
(CVI), and other disorders.

[ Continue Reading][33]

## Providing compression therapy treatments to help people like you feel and live better.

If you have been diagnosed with primary or secondary lymphedema, lymphedema related to cancer
treatment, Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), or arterial conditions such as Peripheral Arterial
Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI), you may be prescribed a compression
therapy device to support your care at home.

Compression therapy can help patients experiencing swelling, venous ulcers, slow-healing wounds,
poor circulation, or discomfort related to venous or arterial insufficiency.

AIROS Medical designs, engineers, and manufactures a full portfolio of therapy solutions — including
Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) for lymphedema and venous complications and the ARTAIRA™
Arterial Compression Device for PAD and CLTI.

For more than 20 years, our team has worked alongside podiatrists, vascular surgeons, wound care
specialists, and certified lymphedema therapists to ensure patients receive safe, effective, and
clinically supported compression therapy. Our mission is simple: help people move, heal, and live
better through proven, accessible technology.

AIROS Medical does not dispense devices directly to patients. Instead, we partner with Durable
Medical Equipment (DME) suppliers who deliver our pumps and garments, provide education, and ensure
patients receive the therapy prescribed by their clinicians.

We understand that when it comes to medical devices, and treatment in general, **patient compliance
is vital to success and outcomes**. Our goal is ultimately to help patients suffering from chronic
diseases **live a better quality of life**.

### Conditions Treated

Our compression therapy devices provide treatment for the following conditions:
* PAD
* Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia
* Diabetic foot ulcers
* Gangrene
* Arterial foot ulcers
* Lymphedema
* Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI)
* Venous Stasis Ulcers
* Other Venous Insufficiencies
* Peripheral Edema

Learn more about the specific [conditions][34] AIROS Medical specializes in treating.

### At-Home Therapy

Our suite of compression therapy devices supports both lymphatic and arterial patient
needs—providing effective home-based treatment that helps patients stay consistent with their care.

For lymphatic and venous patients, our Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) – also known as arm and
leg compression pumps – deliver gentle, gradient pressure designed to help reduce swelling and
improve fluid movement.

For arterial patients, our ARTAIRA™ Arterial Compression Device delivers high-pressure, intermittent
pneumatic compression (IPC) designed to help increase arterial blood flow, support wound healing,
and reduce ischemic discomfort.

Once prescribed either a lymphatic or arterial device, patients are connected with a knowledgeable
DME supplier who guides them through setup and use in the comfort of their homes.

We ensure that each partner in our DME network is well-trained in compression therapy and familiar
with our full portfolio so that clinicians and patients receive the correct therapy for their
condition.

### Intuitive Device Design

Whether supporting lymphatic, venous, or arterial conditions, we design all AIROS Medical devices to
be intuitive, user-friendly, and easy to operate.

DME suppliers and healthcare professionals can quickly set the appropriate pressures, modes, and
cycle times for each device. Patients can begin therapy with just a few button presses—keeping
treatment simple, consistent, and accessible regardless of the condition being managed.

From gentle gradient compression for lymphedema and CVI, to rapid, high-pressure cycles for
improving arterial flow with ARTAIRA™, our entire portfolio was created to support life in motion
and help patients stay consistent with their therapy at home.

### Insurance

Sequential Compression Devices (SCDs) — also referred to as Pneumatic Compression Devices (PCDs) —
are commonly reimbursed by Medicare and most private insurance plans. These devices are used to help
manage lymphedema, Chronic Venous Insufficiency (CVI), and other swelling-related conditions.

For patients with Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD) or Chronic Limb-Threatening Ischemia (CLTI),
arterial compression therapy may also be covered when medically necessary. Coverage varies depending
on diagnosis, clinical documentation, and insurer requirements.

Because every patient’s situation is unique, it’s important to check directly with your Medicare
plan or private insurance carrier to understand what equipment and services are included in your
benefits.

### Products

Our goal with product design has always been to offer high-end devices and garments at an affordable
price for DMEs so that they can remain competitive and support the patients and clinicians they
serve. We have designed and manufactured various Sequential Compression Devices, drawing from
decades in the pneumatic compression space. We launched in 2018 with the AIROS 6 and the AIROS 8,
and have continued to innovate and bring new devices with more features to the market.

The [AIROS 6][34] is a 6-chamber compression pump utilized to treat lymphedema, venous
insufficiencies in the lower limbs, and other complications. The AIROS 6P operates the same way, but
adds the Peristaltic operating mode that is preferred by many lymphedema therapists for upper
extremity treatment.

The [AIROS 8][35] is an 8-chamber compression pump that has a higher reimbursement, namely because
of added features and the ability to change pressures in each garment chamber. The AIROS 8P also
features the Peristaltic Mode, and like the AIROS 6P has a larger pump and 100-240 VAC electrical
rating for use anywhere in the world.

All of our devices are used with our full line of [compression garments][36], available in dozens of
sizes and configurations. The AIROS 6P and AIROS 8P also work with our [truncal compression
garments][37], which are pants-like models that treat abdominal and pelvic swelling.

### Billing

AIROS Medical’s team includes DME industry veterans well-versed in Medicare, Medicaid, and private
insurance regulations around our various products.

We provide knowledge to our DME partners to ensure that compression pumps get billed correctly, and
that the correct paperwork gets completed.

DMEs leverage our expertise in the area of billing and insurance every day to help them be compliant
and successful.
