# MedStar Health Hospital Visiting Hours

Browse this page

## MedStar Health Hospital Visiting Hours

We recognize that visitation is important to healing and recovery—and supporting our patients and
their loved ones is an essential part of how we treat people. We believe that family and loved ones
are cornerstones of patient-centered care and we therefore welcome visitors 24 hours a day, seven
days a week.

Any individual who comes to the hospital is expected to abide by MedStar Health’s Patient and
Visitor Code of Conduct policy. The Patient and Visitor Code of Conduct can be found here:
[MedStarHealth.org/Code-of-Conduct][39].

Overview
* **Normal hours**: Normal visiting hours are from **7 a.m. to 9 p.m. every day**. Behavioral Health
units have their own one to two-hour daily visitation intervals.
* **Quiet hours**: To encourage rest and recovery, quiet hours are held from **9 p.m. to 7 a.m.
every day**. During quiet hours, visitors should avoid noise and disturbances, silence cell phones
and electronic devices, and generally remain in the patient’s room.
* **Number of visitors:** Each patient is permitted a maximum of **two visitors** at any one time.
In alignment with the Support Persons for Patients with Disabilities Policy, one designated
Support Person is allowed for patients with disabilities and is NOT included in the total number
of visitors.
* **Overnight visitors**: During quiet hours, patients are limited to one visitor, who must be at
least 18 years of age. Patients should notify their care team about overnight visitors in advance
whenever possible. The care team will work with patients in double-occupancy rooms to ensure the
comfort and privacy of both patients is equally considered.
* **Security**: All visitors must check in at the Security desk at the hospital entrance to obtain a
badge and return their badge to the Security desk upon departure.
* Any child under the age of 18 must always be accompanied and supervised by an adult who is not the
patient. Generally, no children under the age of 12 years are permitted, though there are some
exceptions noted within the policy.
* Visitors staying overnight must be at least 18 years of age and patients should notify their care
team about overnight visitors in advance whenever possible. The care team will work with patients
in double-occupancy rooms to ensure the comfort and privacy of both patients is equally
considered.
* **Exceptions**: Though we aim to follow these guidelines, there may be clinical or other reasons
why the care team must place additional limits on visitation to ensure the safety and wellbeing of
the patient. In those cases, the care team will provide guidance based on their clinical
assessment.

# Awards and Recognitions: MedStar Health

[Find Care Now][47]
[Contact Us][48]

### Hospital quality ratings

MedStar Health applauds the overall effort to come up with meaningful way to quantify healthcare
safety and enable people to make informed choices. These rating systems continue to improve and will
eventually become more useful. However, the current lack of consistency across the different ratings
organizations that claim to use similar metrics and modeling continues to cause uncertainty, as a
hospital may be rated well in one report but appear to fall short by another measure. In spite of
ratings, studies show that most consumers still choose their doctors based on recommendations by
other doctors, friends, or family members.

MedStar Health makes information on [core quality measures][49] available on our website. We
continue to work with our Patient and Family Advisory Council on Quality and Safety to understand
what would be usable and meaningful information to include online so anyone can easily find it
and—equally important—understand its meaning in simple terms.

### Equity, Inclusion & Diversity Awards and Recognition

At MedStar Health, we are committed to creating a workplace that helps all people feel appreciated,
understood, respected, and connected. It is our responsibility to nurture a strong community that
builds trust and is grounded in equity and inclusion. We are taking bold action to evolve our
organization and improve the health of the communities we serve.

# Our Hospitals

[Contact Us][47]
[Find Care Now][48]

Browse this page

MedStar Health operates 10 hospitals across Baltimore, central Maryland, Washington, D.C., and
southern Maryland. Our facilities offer a full range of healthcare services and are recognized both
regionally and nationally for excellence in medical care.

## [MedStar Franklin Square Medical Center][49]

[Entrance to MedStar Franklin Square Hospital building]

9000 Franklin Square Dr., Baltimore, MD 21237

Accredited by the Joint Commission and certified as a Primary Stroke Center, MedStar Franklin Square
is the largest community teaching hospital in Baltimore. It earned the Magnet Designation for
excellence in nursing, the Delmarva Foundation Award for Quality Excellence, and was included in the
*U.S. News & World Report* Best Hospital specialty ranking for three consecutive years. The hospital
offers leading-edge patient care, treatment, and a full range of world-class services for children
and adults.

[Learn More][50]

## [MedStar Georgetown University Hospital][51]

[MedStar Georgetown University Hospital, Washington DC]

3800 Reservoir Rd. NW, Washington, D.C., 20007

Having garnered a national reputation for medical excellence and leadership, MedStar Georgetown is
committed to offering innovative diagnostic and treatment options within a trusting and
compassionate environment. As an acute-care teaching and research hospital, the hospital’s centers
of excellence include neurosciences, transplantation, cancer, and gastroenterology.

[Learn More][52]

## [MedStar Good Samaritan Hospital][53]

[Photo of MedStar Good Samaritan Hospital]

5601 Loch Raven Blvd., Baltimore, MD 21239

Ensuring high-quality and compassionate medical care since 1968, MedStar Good Samaritan is a
renowned specialty center for rehabilitation. Primary services include cancer care, diabetes,
emergency medicine, geriatrics, orthopedics, vascular care, wellness, and wound healing.

[Learn More][54]

## [MedStar Harbor Hospital][55]

[MedStar Harbor Hospital, Baltimore, MD]

3001 S. Hanover St., Baltimore, MD 21225

Having flourished alongside the community since 1903, MedStar Harbor offers healthcare services to
patients of all age groups. Services include orthopedics, women’s services, cancer care, diabetes
care, fetal assessment, cardiopulmonary rehabilitation, and treatment of chronic lung conditions.

[Learn More][56]

## [MedStar Montgomery Medical Center][57]

[MedStar Montgomery Medical Center front entrance]

18101 Prince Philip Dr., Olney, MD 20832

As a community-centered hospital, MedStar Montgomery strives to offer sophisticated, compassionate
and high-quality medical care in a personal and individualized atmosphere. With advanced medical
technology, the hospital brings world-class specialty care to the community.

[Learn More][58]

## [MedStar National Rehabilitation Hospital][59]

[MedStar National Rehabilitation Hospital, Washington DC]

102 Irving St. NW, Washington, D.C., 20010

The MedStar National Rehabilitation Hospital offers inpatient acute rehabilitation, an extensive
outpatient network of therapy centers, and a unique day treatment program, all designed to
facilitate specialized care to individuals facing disabling injuries and illnesses. The hospital’s
centers of excellence include brain injury and disease, spinal cord injury and disease, stroke
recovery, cardiac rehabilitation, orthopedics, and pediatric rehabilitation.

[Learn More][60]

## [MedStar Southern Maryland Hospital Center][61]

[Front entrance to MedStar Southern Maryland Hospital Center]

7503 Surratts Rd., Clinton, MD 20735

MedStar Southern Maryland is a full-service community hospital specializing in cardiac care,
obstetrics, orthopedics, and surgical services. Providing uncompromising clinical excellence, the
hospital’s specialties also include asthma and allergy care, behavioral health, cancer, emergency
care, radiology, rehabilitation, stroke care, and women’s and newborn services.

[Learn More][62]

## [MedStar St. Mary’s Hospital][63]

[MedStar St. Mary's Hospital]

25500 Point Lookout Rd., Leonardtown, MD 20650

MedStar St. Mary’s offers expert medical services with state-of-the-art emergency, acute inpatient,
and outpatient care. As the only hospital in the region, MedStar St. Mary’s leverages advanced
technology and highly qualified staff with excellence in behavioral health, diabetes management,
hospice, oncology, radiology, orthopedics, wellness, and women’s services.

[Learn More][64]

## [MedStar Union Memorial Hospital][65]

[MedStar Union Memorial Hospital, Baltimore, MD]

201 E. University Pkwy., Baltimore, MD 21218

With a team of highly qualified specialists, MedStar Union Memorial delivers specialized care in a
warm and friendly environment. The hospital has been an integral part of the community for more than
160 years. Its wide range of specialized medical offerings include The Curtis National Hand Center,
cardiology, orthopedics, sports medicine, and various other surgical specialties.

[Learn More][66]

## [MedStar Washington Hospital Center][67]

[Main entrance to MedStar Washington Hospital Center]

110 Irving St. NW, Washington, D.C., 20010

For more than half a century, MedStar Washington has set the highest standard for healthcare—and
reached and surpassed it year after year. As the busiest and largest hospital in Washington, D.C.,
and the surrounding area, the center offers services, programs, and initiatives all aimed at
improving health and quality of life for patients. MedStar Washington demonstrates medical
excellence through services such as the MedStar Heart & Vascular Institute, the region’s only adult
burn center, and the MedSTAR Trauma Center.

[Learn More][68]

# About MedStar Health

[Group photo of MedStar Health medical staff]
[Contact Us][46]

Browse this page

While science is getting better and better at treating people, we’ll never forget the importance of
how we simply treat people. At MedStar Health, we offer easy access to great health care in
Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, D.C., via our 10 [hospitals][47] and more than 300 other care
[locations][48]. We’re also committed to advancing your care by continuously learning and applying
new knowledge. We help our patients and their families feel understood, appreciated, and confident
in their care.

### Our mission

To serve our patients, those who care for them, and our communities.

### Our vision

To be the trusted leader in caring for people and advancing health.

### Our values

**Service **— We strive to anticipate and meet the needs of our patients, physicians, and
co-workers.

**Patient first **— We strive to deliver the best to every patient every day. The patient is the
first priority in everything we do.

**Integrity **— We communicate openly and honestly, build trust, and conduct ourselves according to
the highest ethical standards.

**Respect **— We treat each individual, those we serve and those with whom we work, with the highest
professionalism and dignity.

**Innovation **— We embrace change and work to improve all we do in a fiscally responsible manner.

**Teamwork **— System effectiveness is built on the collective strength and cultural diversity of
everyone, working with open communication and mutual respect.

## MedStar Health—It’s how we treat people

At MedStar Health, we use the best of our minds and the best of our hearts to serve our patients,
those who care for them, and our communities. Our 37,000 associates are committed to living our core
SPIRIT values—Service, Patient first, Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork—no matter where
they work across our diverse health system.

## Patient stories

[See All Patient Stories][49]

### What it means to be non-profit

[Man receives immunization from at vaccination clinic]

As a not-for-profit, community-based healthcare system, we hold ourselves accountable to the people
we serve. For your community, that means more local control to address your local concerns, better
access to care, and the ability to address your community needs.

### Our locations

[A group of medical professionals, shot from a low angle, stands in a lobby and poses for the
camera.]

We strive to make world-class health care accessible through easy access whether you’re being cared
for at one of our physician offices or urgent care centers in your neighborhood, our regional
outpatient centers, or one of our 10 hospitals.

[Learn More][50]

### Facts and figures

[Health professionals and medstar employees]

MedStar Health is an $9 billion not-for-profit, regional healthcare system based in Columbia,
Maryland. We are one of the largest employers in the region with more than 37,000 associates.

[Learn More][51]

### Community impact

[Health professionals]

We are committed to the health and wellness of the communities we serve. Each year, we contribute
more than $300 million in community benefit services such as programs or activities that provide
treatment or promote health and healing as a response to identified community needs.

[Learn More][52]

### Awards and recognition

MedStar Health hospitals are recipients of numerous quality awards and other types of recognition in
all of our 10 hospitals.

[Learn More][53]

### Accountable care

MedStar Accountable Care is proudly participating in the Maryland Primary Care Program (MDPCP) as a
Care Transformation Organization (CTO).

[Learn More][54]

## Meet our MedStar Health leaders

### Leadership

Our physicians, nurses, researchers, and support teams are all focused on one thing—caring for you
and your family. Our leaders are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient-first health care.

[Meet Our Leadership][55]

### Board of directors

Our board of directors are champions of our core mission, vision, and values and helps oversee the
organization’s strategy to serve the best interest of our patients.

[Meet Our Board][56]

## Equity, Inclusion & Diversity

[A diverse group of healthcare professionals poses for a group photo. The photo is taken from a high
angle.]

At MedStar Health, we are committed to creating a workplace that helps all people feel appreciated,
understood, respected, and connected. It is our responsibility to nurture a strong community that
builds trust and is grounded in equity and inclusion.

[Learn More][57]

# About MedStar Health

[Group photo of MedStar Health medical staff]
[Contact Us][46]

Browse this page

While science is getting better and better at treating people, we’ll never forget the importance of
how we simply treat people. At MedStar Health, we offer easy access to great health care in
Maryland, Virginia, and Washington, D.C., via our 10 [hospitals][47] and more than 300 other care
[locations][48]. We’re also committed to advancing your care by continuously learning and applying
new knowledge. We help our patients and their families feel understood, appreciated, and confident
in their care.

### Our mission

To serve our patients, those who care for them, and our communities.

### Our vision

To be the trusted leader in caring for people and advancing health.

### Our values

**Service **— We strive to anticipate and meet the needs of our patients, physicians, and
co-workers.

**Patient first **— We strive to deliver the best to every patient every day. The patient is the
first priority in everything we do.

**Integrity **— We communicate openly and honestly, build trust, and conduct ourselves according to
the highest ethical standards.

**Respect **— We treat each individual, those we serve and those with whom we work, with the highest
professionalism and dignity.

**Innovation **— We embrace change and work to improve all we do in a fiscally responsible manner.

**Teamwork **— System effectiveness is built on the collective strength and cultural diversity of
everyone, working with open communication and mutual respect.

## MedStar Health—It’s how we treat people

At MedStar Health, we use the best of our minds and the best of our hearts to serve our patients,
those who care for them, and our communities. Our 37,000 associates are committed to living our core
SPIRIT values—Service, Patient first, Integrity, Respect, Innovation, and Teamwork—no matter where
they work across our diverse health system.

## Patient stories

[See All Patient Stories][49]

### What it means to be non-profit

[Man receives immunization from at vaccination clinic]

As a not-for-profit, community-based healthcare system, we hold ourselves accountable to the people
we serve. For your community, that means more local control to address your local concerns, better
access to care, and the ability to address your community needs.

### Our locations

[A group of medical professionals, shot from a low angle, stands in a lobby and poses for the
camera.]

We strive to make world-class health care accessible through easy access whether you’re being cared
for at one of our physician offices or urgent care centers in your neighborhood, our regional
outpatient centers, or one of our 10 hospitals.

[Learn More][50]

### Facts and figures

[Health professionals and medstar employees]

MedStar Health is an $9 billion not-for-profit, regional healthcare system based in Columbia,
Maryland. We are one of the largest employers in the region with more than 37,000 associates.

[Learn More][51]

### Community impact

[Health professionals]

We are committed to the health and wellness of the communities we serve. Each year, we contribute
more than $300 million in community benefit services such as programs or activities that provide
treatment or promote health and healing as a response to identified community needs.

[Learn More][52]

### Awards and recognition

MedStar Health hospitals are recipients of numerous quality awards and other types of recognition in
all of our 10 hospitals.

[Learn More][53]

### Accountable care

MedStar Accountable Care is proudly participating in the Maryland Primary Care Program (MDPCP) as a
Care Transformation Organization (CTO).

[Learn More][54]

## Meet our MedStar Health leaders

### Leadership

Our physicians, nurses, researchers, and support teams are all focused on one thing—caring for you
and your family. Our leaders are dedicated to delivering exceptional patient-first health care.

[Meet Our Leadership][55]

### Board of directors

Our board of directors are champions of our core mission, vision, and values and helps oversee the
organization’s strategy to serve the best interest of our patients.

[Meet Our Board][56]

## Equity, Inclusion & Diversity

[A diverse group of healthcare professionals poses for a group photo. The photo is taken from a high
angle.]

At MedStar Health, we are committed to creating a workplace that helps all people feel appreciated,
understood, respected, and connected. It is our responsibility to nurture a strong community that
builds trust and is grounded in equity and inclusion.

[Learn More][57]

#### About Us

#### Welcome to MK Science Set Publishers: Your Gateway to Cutting-Edge Scientific Exploration

In the dynamic realm of scientific exploration, MK Science Set Publishers stands tall as a beacon of
innovation and excellence. As independent international scientific peer-reviewed clinical and
medical journal publishers, we take immense pride in our role as trailblazers, fostering a culture
of knowledge dissemination and collaboration on a global scale.

**Diversity Across Disciplines:** At MK Science Set Publishers, our commitment to advancing
scientific knowledge knows no bounds. With a focus on diverse subject areas such as Clinical,
Medical, Pharma, Biomedical, Life Sciences, Engineering, and Environmental studies, our online
journals encompass a vast array of content types. From in-depth research articles to
thought-provoking opinion pieces, our publications span the breadth and depth of scientific inquiry,
providing a comprehensive resource for scholars, researchers, and enthusiasts alike.

**Unrivaled Peer-Review Process:** What sets us apart as the best open access journal article
publishers is our unwavering dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality. Every piece
of content that graces our journals undergoes a meticulous peer-review process, ensuring that it not
only meets but exceeds the benchmarks of excellence. We take pride in being a trusted source for
rigorously reviewed research, review articles, case reports, and much more.



**Meet Our Team:** Behind the success of MK Science Set Publishers is a team of exceptional
individuals. Our community and advisory board members are not just professionals; they are
visionaries in their respective fields. With diverse expertise and a shared commitment to advancing
knowledge, our team plays a crucial role in discovering and developing new avenues for research and
development within our organization.

**A Vision for Knowledge Sharing:** As we journey forward, MK Science Set Publishers is guided by a
compelling vision — to develop an optimized knowledge-sharing platform and an enlightening
interactive network for researchers across the globe. This vision is not merely aspirational; it's a
strategic commitment to creating an environment where ideas flourish, collaborations thrive, and the
global scientific community evolves collectively.

**Optimized Knowledge-Sharing Platform:** Central to our vision is the creation of a cutting-edge
knowledge-sharing platform. This platform transcends the traditional boundaries of academic
publishing, incorporating innovative features designed to facilitate seamless collaboration,
interdisciplinary interactions, and real-time engagement. Researchers from diverse backgrounds
converge on our platform to contribute to and benefit from a collective pool of knowledge, thereby
propelling the wheels of scientific progress forward.

**Enlightening Interactive Network:** In our pursuit of excellence, MK Science Set Publishers
envisions a future where researchers worldwide are seamlessly connected in an enlightening
interactive network. Through our scientific publications and meetings, we are not only disseminating
knowledge but also fostering an environment where ideas transcend borders, collaboration knows no
limits, and the global scientific community thrives as one interconnected entity.

**Embarking on a Journey of Discovery:** As you explore the world of MK Science Set Publishers,
you're not just engaging with a publisher; you're embarking on a journey of discovery. We invite you
to join us as we redefine the landscape of knowledge dissemination, making science accessible,
collaborative, and impactful for all.

In every article we publish, every meeting we convene, and every interaction we facilitate, MK
Science Set Publishers is committed to upholding the highest standards of scientific integrity and
contributing to the advancement of knowledge that benefits humanity. Join us in this exciting
endeavor, where innovation meets excellence in scientific publishing.

# We produce useful and usable guidance for the NHS and wider health and care system.

Our recommendations help practitioners and commissioners get the best care to people, fast, while
ensuring value for the taxpayer.

[Find guidance][11]

## Latest from NICE

### [New draft PMOS guideline recommends annual review and could mean quicker diagnosis][12]

People with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) should have their condition diagnosed
sooner and be offered an annual review to monitor symptoms, treatment and long-term health risks,
according to our draft guideline published for public consultation today.

News01 July 2026
1. ### [New technologies could help cut years-long wait for endometriosis diagnosis, says NICE][13]
   
   Two new non-invasive diagnostic technologies can be used in the NHS while further evidence is
   generated to speed up the diagnosis of endometriosis in primary care.
   
   News07 July 2026
2. ### [From hospital to home][14]
   
   Hear from Leslie, a heart failure patient, his wife and carer Anne, and his consultant Dr Andrew
   Flett and discover how a NICE-recommended sensor the size of a paperclip is transforming heart
   failure care. Evidence from 3 randomised controlled trials shows it reduces hospitalisations by
   34%.
   
   In-depth29 June 2026
3. ### [New treatment option recommended for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer][15]
   
   A new treatment option is now available on the NHS for cervical cancer that has come back or
   spread to other parts of the body, following our final draft guidance published today.
   
   News24 June 2026

[View all news, blogs and podcasts][16]

## Backing the healthtech that changes lives

Ammaarah spent years just surviving with type 1 diabetes.
Now she's thriving, with hybrid closed loop technology managing her insulin.

[Developing or adopting healthtech? Learn more][17]

## Implementation and planning

Best practice resources for practitioners and commissioners.

[Quality improvement - using our standards and indicators][18]

Helping you define, improve and measure quality in health, public health and social care.

[Guidelines and resources for social care][19]

Resources and recommendations for adult and children’s social care, with example scenarios to help
put them into practice.

[Productivity, planning and cost saving resources][20]

Explore ways to plan, save money and make decisions on the best ways to use resources.

## More ways we support you

Useful sources of information and advice for healthcare professionals, patients, parents and carers.

[Advice and information on the use of drugs][21]

The British National Formulary (BNF) provides information about the selection, prescribing,
dispensing and administration of drugs.

[Summaries of evidence and advice on common health topics ][22]

With over 370 topics to choose from, clinical knowledge summaries (CKS) can provide quick answers to
clinical questions.

[Making decisions about your care][23]

Our patient decision aids (PDAs) include treatment options available, likely outcomes, benefits,
harms and uncertainties.

## Modular updates window now open

Modular updates focus on reviewing specific methods or processes used to develop NICE guidance.
Submit your ideas and suggestions from Monday 15 June to Sunday 16 August.

[Learn more about modular updates][24]

## How NICE's independent committees help us develop our recommendations

Debra Quantrill was 38 when she had a life-changing heart attack. Now she’s working as a patient
representative on one of NICE’s independent committees. Find out how you can [join a NICE
independent committee][25] and make a real difference to patient care.

# We produce useful and usable guidance for the NHS and wider health and care system.

Our recommendations help practitioners and commissioners get the best care to people, fast, while
ensuring value for the taxpayer.

[Find guidance][11]

## Latest from NICE

### [New draft PMOS guideline recommends annual review and could mean quicker diagnosis][12]

People with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) should have their condition diagnosed
sooner and be offered an annual review to monitor symptoms, treatment and long-term health risks,
according to our draft guideline published for public consultation today.

News01 July 2026
1. ### [New technologies could help cut years-long wait for endometriosis diagnosis, says NICE][13]
   
   Two new non-invasive diagnostic technologies can be used in the NHS while further evidence is
   generated to speed up the diagnosis of endometriosis in primary care.
   
   News07 July 2026
2. ### [From hospital to home][14]
   
   Hear from Leslie, a heart failure patient, his wife and carer Anne, and his consultant Dr Andrew
   Flett and discover how a NICE-recommended sensor the size of a paperclip is transforming heart
   failure care. Evidence from 3 randomised controlled trials shows it reduces hospitalisations by
   34%.
   
   In-depth29 June 2026
3. ### [New treatment option recommended for recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer][15]
   
   A new treatment option is now available on the NHS for cervical cancer that has come back or
   spread to other parts of the body, following our final draft guidance published today.
   
   News24 June 2026

[View all news, blogs and podcasts][16]

## Backing the healthtech that changes lives

Ammaarah spent years just surviving with type 1 diabetes.
Now she's thriving, with hybrid closed loop technology managing her insulin.

[Developing or adopting healthtech? Learn more][17]

## Implementation and planning

Best practice resources for practitioners and commissioners.

[Quality improvement - using our standards and indicators][18]

Helping you define, improve and measure quality in health, public health and social care.

[Guidelines and resources for social care][19]

Resources and recommendations for adult and children’s social care, with example scenarios to help
put them into practice.

[Productivity, planning and cost saving resources][20]

Explore ways to plan, save money and make decisions on the best ways to use resources.

## More ways we support you

Useful sources of information and advice for healthcare professionals, patients, parents and carers.

[Advice and information on the use of drugs][21]

The British National Formulary (BNF) provides information about the selection, prescribing,
dispensing and administration of drugs.

[Summaries of evidence and advice on common health topics ][22]

With over 370 topics to choose from, clinical knowledge summaries (CKS) can provide quick answers to
clinical questions.

[Making decisions about your care][23]

Our patient decision aids (PDAs) include treatment options available, likely outcomes, benefits,
harms and uncertainties.

## Modular updates window now open

Modular updates focus on reviewing specific methods or processes used to develop NICE guidance.
Submit your ideas and suggestions from Monday 15 June to Sunday 16 August.

[Learn more about modular updates][24]

# About the Journal

The National Medical Journal of India, a publication of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences,
is a peer-reviewed print and online journal. The journal’s full text is available online at
[http://www.nmji.in][90]. The journal allows free access (Open Access) to its contents and permits
authors to self-archive final accepted version of the articles on any OAI-compliant institutional /
subject-based repository.

Impact Factor® as reported in the 2020 Journal Citation Reports® (Clarivate Analytics, 2021):
**0.537**

#### Role of The Journal/Society

**Editorial Process and Direction:** The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Delhi
plays a central role in the editorial direction of the journal “The National Medical Journal of
India”. Specifically:
* **Editorial Board Appointment:** The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Delhi
appoints the Editor-in-Chief and oversees the composition of the editorial board.
* **Editorial Policy and Scope:** The aims and scope of the journal are determined by the All India
Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Delhi in consultation with the editorial board to ensure
alignment with the Association’s mission and the needs for the community.
* **Peer Review Process and Final Decisions:** The Editor-in-Chief, who is appointed by and reports
to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Delhi manages the peer review process,
makes final decisions on manuscripts, and ensures editorial independence and scientific integrity.
* **Strategic Direction:** Major decisions regarding journal strategy, policy updates, or editorial
initiatives are made under the guidance of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS),
Delhi Executive Committee.

#### Role of Scientific Scholar

Scientific Scholar serves solely as the publishing partner, providing publishing infrastructure,
manuscript management system, website hosting, copyediting, production, and distribution services to
support the journal’s publication process. Scientific Scholar does not influence or participate in
the editorial decisions or the peer review process.

#### Aims & Scope

The journal will cover technical and clinical studies related to health, ethical and social issues
in field of health policy and health provider training through sections on ‘Medicine and society’
and ‘Medical education’.. Articles with clinical interest and implications will be given preference.

#### Audience

Our audience includes readers and practitioners from Medical science, through experimentation,
observation, theoretical knowledge, and practical exposure.

#### Review process

NMJI has a highly rigorous peer-review process that makes sure that manuscripts are scientifically
accurate, relevant, novel and important. Authors disclose all conflicts, affiliations and financial
associations such that the published content is not biased.

#### Editorial Team

The editorial board comprises a panel of experts from various disciplines of medical and allied
sciences to provide their expertise and guidance in maintaining the clarity of content and focus of
the purpose for the journal.

#### Journal Ethics

The National Medical Journal of India is committed to meeting and upholding the standards of ethical
behavior at all stages of the publication process. We follow closely the industry associations, such
as the Committee on Publication Ethics (COPE), International Committee of Medical Journal Editors
(ICMJE) and World Association of Medical Editors (WAME), that set standards and provide guidelines
for best practices in order to meet these requirements. For a summary of our specific policies
regarding duplicate publication, conflicts of interest, patient consent, etc., please visit our
[Ethical Guidelines section][92]

#### Plagiarism Policy

The journal uses plagiarism check software ([iThenticate][93]) on the Editor’s and Reviewer’s panel
in the manuscript management system which is used to check and control Plagiarism for each article.
Any manuscript, that is found to have plagiarism is rejected.

#### Archival Policy

We use [PORTICO][94] for our third-party repository for all articles published with us. All our
articles are assigned a DOI number. We are members of [https://crossref.org][95]

#### Open Access Publication and Creative Commons Licensing

The National Medical Journal of India is an open-access journal, and manuscripts published are
distributed under the terms of the [Creative Commons Attribution-Non Commercial-Share Alike 4.0][96]
License (CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0), which allows others to remix, transform, and build upon the work
non-commercially, as long as appropriate credit is given and the new creations are licensed under
the identical terms.

#### **Data Sharing Policy**

NIH funded researchers, please follow the NIH guidelines on Data sharing as given at:
https://grants.nih.gov/grants/guide/notice-files/NOT-OD-21-013.html

#### Ahead of Print policy

Articles published online under the Ahead of Print model are considered published and can be cited
and quoted using the DOI as the reference source. The National Medical Journal of India has a policy
that changes will not be made after the publication of an article without following accepted
procedures for making corrections to the scientific record.

#### Advertisements

While advertisements are crucial to this journal to be able to keep all content free for everyone,
ethical considerations are in place to ensure the integrity of the journal and its content are not
biased or influenced by the advertisement.

“Pop-up” and “banner” advertisement appears at a fixed location on the page and does not interfere
with the manuscript in any form.

The Editorial Board has full and final approval over the content of all advertisements.

Advertisers will never be shown any manuscripts or other content prior to publication.

## Helpful Information

The last thing you want is your time wasted with a confusing service, our [Knowledge Base][27] has
you covered. If you have any questions, reach out to our Customer Support Team via email:
[[email protected]][28]

#### [Are your CEU’s approved and accredited?][29]

Yes! Nursing CE Central is approved by ANCC and accepted by every Board of Nursing for every state;
ensuring that your contact hours and certificates are valid, regardless of your state(s) of
practice.

#### [Are tests required to complete CEU’s?][30]

No, Nursing CE Central does not require tests upon completing courses.* Simply read the material,
attest that you studied it, and receive your certificate instantly!

*The only instances of needing to take a test are for states that require it.

#### [What license levels do you offer?][31]

Nursing CE Central offers every course required to renew RN, LVN, and APRN licenses in every state.
However, your Incredible Health subscription only applies to RN and LVN level courses.

#### [What is included in enrollment?][32]

Your enrollment includes every course required for your CEU renewals, no matter what state you’re
in.

Your enrollment also includes valid certificates for every course you complete, and are sent to your
email and can be accessed 24/7 in your Nursing CE Central profile.

#### [Are your courses available online?][33]

Yes! The courses are designed to provide maximal convenience and ease-of-use for nurses. You can
take courses on any device, anywhere, at any time.

#### [How do I complete my CE’s after paying?][34]

After you log in, you will be directed to the “Take Courses” page, with all courses available for
you to take at your convenience.

When you reach the end of a course, you will be prompted to click a green “Complete Course” button.
Upon clicking that button, you will be sent to a confirmation page, and your certificate will be
immediately sent to your email.

all_classified.polished_summary: Nursing CE Central is a leading provider of nursing continuing education units (CEUs), offering a comprehensive course library approved by the ANCC and accepted by nursing boards across all states. The platform allows nurses to complete their required courses effortlessly, without tests, and provides instant certificates upon course completion. With a focus on convenience and accessibility, Nursing CE Central caters to registered nurses (RNs), licensed vocational nurses (LVNs), and advanced practice registered nurses (APRNs) seeking to fulfill their professional development requirements efficiently.

all_classified.company_summary: Okheart, operating as the Oklahoma Heart Hospital, is a leading provider of cardiovascular care, featuring a network of over 80 specialists across more than 60 locations in Oklahoma. The hospital is dedicated to advancing heart health through innovative research, comprehensive patient services, and a commitment to community education, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for patients.

### Provider Directory

At Oklahoma Heart Hospital, we want to make finding a doctor as easy as possible. Our physician
directory lets you search by physician name, location or specialty so you can find the right doctor
for your needs. Select from among more than 80 cardiovascular specialists in the OHH Physicians
group that serve Oklahoma in more than 60 locations across the state.

[Find a Provider][51]

[stethoscope on scrubs]

### MyOHH

MyOHH is an excellent way to stay connected with your doctor. This secure, internet-based gateway
gives you digital access to your health information, allows you to request and schedule
appointments, refill prescriptions, check test results and maintain email contact with your
physician or nurse. As a patient, you’re automatically granted access to MyOHH.

[Learn About MyOHH][52]

[woman using app]

### What to Expect on Your Visit

Now that you have an appointment with an OHH physician, learn more on how you can prepare for your
upcoming visit.

[Learn What to Expect][53]

[OHH lobby]

### Research Innovation

Through research comes innovation. Through innovation come new avenues of prevention and treatment.
The Oklahoma Heart Hospital Research Foundation (OHHRF) helps reduce the impact and severity of
heart disease through clinical research, continuing medical education and community service.

[Research Foundation][54]

[physician looking at monitor]

### Clinic Directory

Among Oklahoma Heart Hospital’s family of clinics, there’s a clinic that is just right for you. This
easy-to-use search tool allows you to locate OHH heart clinics by city and provider.

**PENUMBRA SYSTEM RED – Indication for Use**
**Penumbra Reperfusion Catheters and Separators**
As part of the PENUMBRA SYSTEM, the Reperfusion Catheters and Separators are indicated for use in
the revascularization of patients with acute ischemic stroke secondary to intracranial large vessel
occlusive disease (within the internal carotid, middle cerebral – M1 and M2 segments, basilar, and
vertebral arteries) within 8 hours of symptom onset. Patients who are ineligible for intravenous
tissue plasminogen activator (IV t-PA) or who fail IV t-PA therapy are candidates for treatment.
**Penumbra Aspiration Tubing**
As part of the PENUMBRA SYSTEM, the Penumbra Sterile Aspiration Tubing is indicated to connect the
Penumbra Reperfusion Catheters to the Penumbra Aspiration Pump.
**Penumbra Aspiration Pump**
The Penumbra Aspiration Pump is indicated as a vacuum source for Penumbra Aspiration Systems
**Contraindications**
There are no known contraindications
**Warnings**
• The device is intended for single use only. Do not resterilize or reuse. Resterilization and/or
Reuse may result in ineffective catheter coating lubrication, which may result in high friction and
the inability to access the target neuro vasculature location.
• Do not use kinked or damaged devices. Do not use open or damaged packages. Return all damaged
devices and packaging to the manufacturer/distributor.
• Do not use automated high-pressure contrast injection equipment with the Penumbra Reperfusion
Catheter because it may damage the device.
• Confirm vessel diameter, and select an appropriate size Penumbra Reperfusion Catheter. Do not use
in arteries with diameters smaller or equal to the distal outer diameter of the Penumbra Reperfusion
Catheters. Refer to the Reperfusion Catheter labeling for dimensional information.
• Do not advance, retract or use any component of the Penumbra System against resistance without
careful assessment of the cause using fluoroscopy. If the cause cannot be determined, withdraw the
device or system as a unit. Unrestrained torquing or forced insertion of the catheter or SEPARATOR™
against resistance may result in damage to the device or vessel.
• Do not use the Penumbra System with a pump other than the Penumbra Aspiration Pump.
• Failure to abide by the warnings in this labeling might result in damage to the device coating,
which may necessitate intervention or result in serious adverse events.
**Precautions**
• The Penumbra System should only be used by physicians who have received appropriate training in
interventional neuro-endovascular techniques and treatment of acute ischemic stroke.
• Use prior to the “Use By” date.

Risk Information

**PENUMBRA SYSTEM RED – Indication for Use**
**Penumbra Reperfusion Catheters and Separators**
As part of the PENUMBRA SYSTEM, the Reperfusion Catheters and Separators are indicated for use in
the revascularization of patients with acute ischemic stroke secondary to intracranial large vessel
occlusive disease (within the internal carotid, middle cerebral – M1 and M2 segments, basilar, and
vertebral arteries) within 8 hours of symptom onset. Patients who are ineligible for intravenous
tissue plasminogen activator (IV t-PA) or who fail IV t-PA therapy are candidates for treatment.
**Penumbra Aspiration Tubing**
As part of the PENUMBRA SYSTEM, the Penumbra Sterile Aspiration Tubing is indicated to connect the
Penumbra Reperfusion Catheters to the Penumbra Aspiration Pump.
**Penumbra Aspiration Pump**
The Penumbra Aspiration Pump is indicated as a vacuum source for Penumbra Aspiration Systems
**Contraindications**
There are no known contraindications
**Warnings**
• The device is intended for single use only. Do not resterilize or reuse. Resterilization and/or
Reuse may result in ineffective catheter coating lubrication, which may result in high friction and
the inability to access the target neuro vasculature location.
• Do not use kinked or damaged devices. Do not use open or damaged packages. Return all damaged
devices and packaging to the manufacturer/distributor.
• Do not use automated high-pressure contrast injection equipment with the Penumbra Reperfusion
Catheter because it may damage the device.
• Confirm vessel diameter, and select an appropriate size Penumbra Reperfusion Catheter. Do not use
in arteries with diameters smaller or equal to the distal outer diameter of the Penumbra Reperfusion
Catheters. Refer to the Reperfusion Catheter labeling for dimensional information.
• Do not advance, retract or use any component of the Penumbra System against resistance without
careful assessment of the cause using fluoroscopy. If the cause cannot be determined, withdraw the
device or system as a unit. Unrestrained torquing or forced insertion of the catheter or SEPARATOR™
against resistance may result in damage to the device or vessel.
• Do not use the Penumbra System with a pump other than the Penumbra Aspiration Pump.
• Failure to abide by the warnings in this labeling might result in damage to the device coating,
which may necessitate intervention or result in serious adverse events.
**Precautions**
• The Penumbra System should only be used by physicians who have received appropriate training in
interventional neuro-endovascular techniques and treatment of acute ischemic stroke.
• Use prior to the “Use By” date.
• Use the Penumbra System in conjunction with fluoroscopic visualization.
• As in all fluoroscopy procedures, consider all necessary precautions to limit patient radiation
exposure by using sufficient shielding, reducing fluoroscopy times and modifying radiation technical
factors whenever possible.
• Maintain a constant infusion of appropriate flush solution.
• When performing aspiration, ensure that the Penumbra Aspiration Tubing valve is open for only the
minimum time needed to remove thrombus. Excessive aspiration or failure to close the Penumbra
Aspiration Tubing valve when aspiration is complete is not recommended.
• The Penumbra Separator is not intended for use as a neurovascular guidewire. If repositioning of
the Penumbra Reperfusion Catheter is necessary during the revascularization procedure, such
reposition should be performed over an appropriate neurovascular guidewire using standard
microcatheter and guidewire techniques.
• Administration of anticoagulants and antiplatelets should be suspended until 24 hours
post-treatment. Medical management and acute post stroke care should follow the ASA guidelines.1 Any
neurological deterioration should be evaluated by urgent CT scan and other evaluations as indicated
according to investigator/hospital best practice.
• As in all surgical interventions, monitoring of intra-procedural blood loss is recommended so that
appropriate management may be instituted.
• Avoid using alcohol, antiseptic solutions, or other solvents to pre-treat the device because this
may cause unpredictable changes in the coating which could affect the device safety and performance.
**Potential Adverse Events**
Possible complications include, but are not limited to, the following:
allergic reaction and anaphylaxis from contrast media; acute occlusion; air embolism; arteriovenous
fistula; death; device malfunction; distal embolization; emboli; false aneurysm formation; hematoma
or hemorrhage at access site; inability to completely remove thrombus; infection; intracranial
hemorrhage; ischemia; kidney damage from contrast media; neurological deficits including stroke;
vessel spasm, thrombosis, dissection, or perforation; radiation exposure that may lead to cataracts,
skin reddening, burns, alopecia, or neoplasia from x-ray exposure.

all_classified.polished_summary: Penumbra, Inc. is a global healthcare company dedicated to innovating advanced medical technologies aimed at improving patient outcomes. Specializing in neuro and vascular solutions, the company offers a range of products, including the THUNDERBOLT® platform for stroke thrombectomy and various embolization and access devices. With a commitment to enhancing clinical care, Penumbra serves healthcare providers and patients across multiple therapeutic areas.

all_classified.company_summary: Preventing Hospital-acquired Venous Thromboembolism is dedicated to enhancing patient safety by implementing strategies and best practices aimed at reducing the incidence of venous thromboembolism (VTE) in healthcare settings. The organization focuses on providing resources and guidance to hospitals and healthcare providers, ensuring that patients receive optimal care and minimizing the risks associated with hospital stays. Its target market includes hospitals, healthcare systems, and medical professionals committed to improving patient outcomes and safety.

Frequently asked questions

Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?

Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.

What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?

Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.

How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?

Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.

Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?

Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to a PowerPoint.

Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?

Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design before presenting.

 Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?

Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that makes content more engaging and memorable.

How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?

While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.

What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?

With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.

Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?

Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical flow and creating a consistent design.

Frequently asked questions

Can I create a Prezi presentation from my PowerPoint slides?

Yes. Prezi makes it easy to transform your existing PowerPoint presentation into something dynamic. Simply upload your PowerPoint slide deck to Prezi Present, and our tools will help you convert it into an interactive Prezi presentation. You can also import files from Google Slides or Keynote by exporting them as PDFs first.

What is Prezi’s AI presentation maker?

Prezi AI is an AI presentation maker that helps you create a complete, polished presentation from a prompt or uploaded file, like a PDF, PPT, or DOC. It generates a structured draft with suggested slide titles, key points, and design theme so you can move from idea to presentation faster.

How does Prezi's AI presentation designer work?

Prezi's AI presentation designer turns your ideas into polished presentations effortlessly. After entering a prompt or uploading an existing file like a PDF or Word document, Prezi AI generates a complete presentation with customized layouts, AI images, and visual elements. You can then make final tweaks with our AI image generator and text editor before presenting.

Can Prezi create a PowerPoint (PPT) with AI?

Yes. If you want an AI PowerPoint presentation maker workflow, you can use Prezi AI to draft your presentation quickly and then export or share it in the format your team needs, like exporting to a PowerPoint.

Can I turn an existing document into a presentation with AI?

Yes. Prezi AI can help you create a presentation with AI from existing content. Add a prompt or upload content, and Prezi AI generates an outline and slide-by-slide draft with layouts and visuals you can refine. You stay in control and can edit text, reorder slides, and adjust design before presenting.

 Is Prezi a free AI presentation tool?

Yes, Prezi is available as a free presentation software with AI-powered features included. If you want unlimited access to Prezi AI, you can try a free trial or upgrade to a paid subscription. No matter which subscription you choose, you will be able to present with Prezi's unique format that makes content more engaging and memorable.

How is Prezi different from other AI presentation generators?

While most AI presentation tools force your content into generic templates, Prezi AI takes a smarter approach. Based on your unique content, Prezi AI generates a presentation with custom design, colors, and images specifically tailored to your message, no templates required. Your content provides all the direction needed to create a truly personalized presentation.

What types of presentations can I create with Prezi AI?

With Prezi AI, you can create presentations for work, school, and personal projects, including pitch decks, reports, lessons, and slide presentations. If you are looking to make a presentation with AI for work or school, Prezi AI can help you draft faster and present more effectively.

Does Prezi AI help with slide structure and talking points?

Yes. Prezi AI helps with the parts that take the most time, like organizing ideas into a logical flow and creating a consistent design.

Can I edit the AI-generated presentation?

Absolutely. Prezi AI creates a draft, but you can fully edit it. Update the text, rearrange slides, and tailor the visuals so the final result matches your brand, audience, and goals.

Is Prezi good for creating slide decks with AI for teams?

Yes. Prezi works well for collaborative workflows where multiple people need to review, refine, and align on messaging. If you’re looking for an AI presentation software that keeps presentations consistent across your organization with shared collaboration features and team-friendly controls,
Prezi for Teams is an ideal solution.

What should I include in a prompt for the best AI presentation results?

For the best results, include your audience, goal, topic, tone, and any must-have points. Example: “Create a 10-slide deck for mid-market HR leaders about onboarding software, highlight three benefits, include a comparison slide, and a strong CTA.” For even more prompt examples, you can explore our
AI prompt library to get inspired.

Is Prezi AI suitable for beginners who are new to presentation design?

Yes. Prezi AI is built to help beginners get a high-quality first draft quickly, with suggested structure and slide content. It reduces the time spent figuring out what to say and how to organize it, so you can focus on accuracy and delivery.

How does Prezi AI help me create presentations?

Prezi AI helps with every stage of presentation creation, including:

Outline: Use Prezi AI to help you structure the outline for your presentation.
Design: Prezi AI can suggest design elements, color palettes, and layouts.
Content: Prezi AI can help with generating text and visuals based on your outline.
Refine: Review and edit the AI-generated content to ensure it aligns with your goals.

What are the benefits of AI for presentations?

Writing clear and concise AI prompts is essential for streamlining your workflow and generating high-quality presentations using AI presentation makers. Here are some key tips to consider when creating your presentation with Prezi AI:

Define your focus: Be specific about the central topic of your presentation.
Tailor for impact: Consider your audience and adjust the prompt accordingly.
Paint a picture with words: Describe your desired visual style and tone.
Keywords & tone: Include relevant keywords and specify the desired tone.
Cost savings: By automating various aspects of presentation creation and delivery, the AI presentation maker can help you reduce costs associated with design and manual content adjustments.

By following these tips, you can effectively communicate your vision to Prezi AI and create impactful presentations that align with your goals. Remember to be specific and clear and keep your presentation description concise and easy-to-understand.

What is a generative AI presentation?

A generative AI presentation is one that is created or partially created using artificial intelligence. This can include generating ideas, designing slides and frames, or creating content.

What is the best way to deliver an AI presentation?

Whether you're delivering an AI presentation on business topics or educational concepts, make sure to tailor your content to your audience's knowledge and interests. Use clear language, break down complex concepts, and use visuals to improve understanding.

Also, make sure to engage your audience by asking questions, encouraging participation, and making the presentation interactive. Finally, practice your presentation speech and seek feedback. Furthermore, you can explore resources like Prezi
templates or examples for inspiration.

For more information on how to effectively deliver presentations, read
this article . 

Why should I use Prezi AI?

Prezi AI helps save you time and lets you focus on the work that really matters. With AI, you can automate repetitive tasks, spark creativity and find new ideas, and enhance your content. Prezi AI helps in other ways, too, like audience engagement. Quickly tailor your content to your audience’s preferences and keep them interested for your entire presentation.

How to make animations with AI

Prezi AI can help you create animated slides from bullet points. Simply enter your bullet points, and Prezi AI will offer to automatically generate visually appealing and animated slides. You can customize the slides and overall style to match your preferences.

How to use AI visuals and animations in Prezi

With Prezi, you can improve your presentations by incorporating AI-generated visuals. Simply upload your AI visuals and tailor your presentation to match your desired outcome. 

Also, you can bring your bullet points to life by turning them into visual stories with the help of AI. In a few clicks, you can turn dull bullet points into dynamic, animated slides. You can customize these transitions to fit your style and ultimately create a more dynamic and impactful presentation.

## Frequently asked questions
* ### Is Prezi down?

Check the operational status of Prezi features or components at [status.prezi.com][24].
* ### How can I reach out to Support?

All support requests are handled through our online ticketing system once you are logged in. Basic
users: For technical support, you can refer to our Knowledge Base: support.prezi.com, or use one
of the forms above for non-technical requests. Standard or above: Submit a ticket via the support
request form or open a chat in the editor during business hours. Note: We no longer offer phone
support. Please submit a support request after logging in.
* ### What is the typical response time?

You can expect a response within our standard support SLA (typically 24–72 business hours).
* ### I have a question about data protection and/or privacy. How can I get in contact?

Please email [privacy@prezi.com][25] and we'll get back to you as soon as we can. For more
information, you can also review our Privacy Policy [here][26].
* ### Where can I learn about European Data Subject Rights?

Please refer to the "Data Subject Rights" section in the [Privacy Policy][27]. You can also email
[privacy@prezi.com][28] if anything is unclear.
* ### How do I cancel my subscription or delete my account on Prezi?

You can manage or cancel your subscription directly from your account settings page by selecting
the License tab. Click here for [step-by-step instructions][29], or click here to [submit a
support ticket.][30] Once you’ve canceled your subscription, you can delete your account by
following the steps here. If you need further assistance, please submit a support ticket after
logging in.
* ### I'm having trouble logging in or forgot my password.

Visit our login troubleshooting article for step-by-step guidance including password resets. If
you still need help, submit a support ticket.
* ### My trial is about to expire. What are my options?

Prezi's subscriptions renew automatically. If you don't cancel before your trial ends, you'll be
charged for the renewal of a paid subscription. If you do not want to continue with a paid
subscription, you can cancel your trial and continue with our free Basic plan, where you'll still
be able to access your existing presentations but some features will be limited. To explore plan
options and pricing, visit our Pricing page. If you have questions about your plan or need help
with billing, visit our Billing support page or submit a ticket after logging in.

**How does Prezi AI help me create presentations?**

Prezi AI helps with every stage of presentation creation, including:
1. **Outline: **Use Prezi AI to help you structure the outline for your presentation.
2. **Design: **Prezi AI can suggest design elements, color palettes, and layouts.
3. **Content:** Prezi AI can help with generating text and visuals based on your outline.
4. **Refine:** Review and edit the AI-generated content to ensure it aligns with your goals.

What are the benefits of AI for presentations?

Writing clear and concise AI prompts is essential for streamlining your workflow and generating
high-quality presentations using AI presentation makers. Here are some key tips to consider when
creating your presentation with Prezi AI:
1. **Define your focus:** Be specific about the central topic of your presentation.
2. **Tailor for impact: **Consider your audience and adjust the prompt accordingly.
3. **Paint a picture with words: **Describe your desired visual style and tone.
4. **Keywords & tone: **Include relevant keywords and specify the desired tone.
5. **Cost savings: **By automating various aspects of presentation creation and delivery, the AI
presentation maker can help you reduce costs associated with design and manual content
adjustments.

By following these tips, you can effectively communicate your vision to Prezi AI and create
impactful presentations that align with your goals. Remember to be specific and clear and keep your
presentation description concise and easy-to-understand.

**What is a generative AI presentation?**

A generative AI presentation is one that is created or partially created using artificial
intelligence. This can include generating ideas, designing slides and frames, or creating content.

**What is the best way to deliver an AI presentation? **

Whether you're delivering an AI presentation on business topics or educational concepts, make sure
to tailor your content to your audience's knowledge and interests. Use clear language, break down
complex concepts, and use visuals to improve understanding.

Also, make sure to engage your audience by asking questions, encouraging participation, and making
the presentation interactive. Finally, practice your presentation speech and seek feedback.
Furthermore, you can explore resources like Prezi [templates][31] or [examples][32] for inspiration.

For more information on how to effectively deliver presentations, read [this article][33].

**Why should I use Prezi AI?**

Prezi AI helps save you time and lets you focus on the work that really matters. With AI, you can
automate repetitive tasks, spark creativity and find new ideas, and enhance your content. Prezi AI
helps in other ways, too, like audience engagement. Quickly tailor your content to your audience’s
preferences and keep them interested for your entire presentation.

**How to make animations with AI**

Prezi AI can help you create animated slides from bullet points. Simply enter your bullet points,
and Prezi AI will offer to automatically generate visually appealing and animated slides. You can
customize the slides and overall style to match your preferences.

**How to use AI visuals and animations in Prezi**

With Prezi, you can improve your presentations by incorporating AI-generated visuals. Simply upload
your AI visuals and tailor your presentation to match your desired outcome.

Also, you can bring your bullet points to life by turning them into visual stories with the help of
AI. In a few clicks, you can turn dull bullet points into dynamic, animated slides. You can
customize these transitions to fit your style and ultimately create a more dynamic and impactful
presentation.

# About Quizlet

## Making every student unstoppable

At Quizlet, we believe that anyone can learn anything. All it takes is a tenacious spirit, the right
guidance, and the tools to see it through. We know that students are under more pressure than ever.
It can leave them overwhelmed, be anxiety-producing and make it all too easy to burn out.

It’s our job to give every student the tools and confidence to succeed, no matter what their
motivation, or what they’re striving to achieve.

Read our impact report
][3]

## * 60 *
## million learners

## * 900+ *
## million study sets

## * 2 in 3 *
## US high school students use Quizlet

## It started with a victory

In 2005 Andrew Sutherland created a studying tool to help him ace a French vocabulary test. He aced
it. And shared it with his friends. Who started acing their tests. And now, more than a decade
later, 60 million students and learners use Quizlet for everything from math tests to medical exams
to, well, French vocabulary quizzes.

## From a single classroom to schools around the world

What started as a simple tool has grown into seven different study modes, tools to help teachers get
the most out of their students, and activities to help classes learn and have fun together. And
that’s just the start. We’re working on unleashing the magic of one-on-one learning for every
student, shaping the future of personalized learning through an assistant to help guide and motivate
every learner.

# About Quizlet

## Making every student unstoppable

At Quizlet, we believe that anyone can learn anything. All it takes is a tenacious spirit, the right
guidance, and the tools to see it through. We know that students are under more pressure than ever.
It can leave them overwhelmed, be anxiety-producing and make it all too easy to burn out.

It’s our job to give every student the tools and confidence to succeed, no matter what their
motivation, or what they’re striving to achieve.

Read our impact report
][3]

## * 60 *
## million learners

## * 900+ *
## million study sets

## * 2 in 3 *
## US high school students use Quizlet

## It started with a victory

In 2005 Andrew Sutherland created a studying tool to help him ace a French vocabulary test. He aced
it. And shared it with his friends. Who started acing their tests. And now, more than a decade
later, 60 million students and learners use Quizlet for everything from math tests to medical exams
to, well, French vocabulary quizzes.

## From a single classroom to schools around the world

What started as a simple tool has grown into seven different study modes, tools to help teachers get
the most out of their students, and activities to help classes learn and have fun together. And
that’s just the start. We’re working on unleashing the magic of one-on-one learning for every
student, shaping the future of personalized learning through an assistant to help guide and motivate
every learner.

# About Quizlet

## Making every student unstoppable

At Quizlet, we believe that anyone can learn anything. All it takes is a tenacious spirit, the right
guidance, and the tools to see it through. We know that students are under more pressure than ever.
It can leave them overwhelmed, be anxiety-producing and make it all too easy to burn out.

It’s our job to give every student the tools and confidence to succeed, no matter what their
motivation, or what they’re striving to achieve.

Read our impact report
][3]

## * 60 *
## million learners

## * 900+ *
## million study sets

## * 2 in 3 *
## US high school students use Quizlet

## It started with a victory

In 2005 Andrew Sutherland created a studying tool to help him ace a French vocabulary test. He aced
it. And shared it with his friends. Who started acing their tests. And now, more than a decade
later, 60 million students and learners use Quizlet for everything from math tests to medical exams
to, well, French vocabulary quizzes.

## From a single classroom to schools around the world

What started as a simple tool has grown into seven different study modes, tools to help teachers get
the most out of their students, and activities to help classes learn and have fun together. And
that’s just the start. We’re working on unleashing the magic of one-on-one learning for every
student, shaping the future of personalized learning through an assistant to help guide and motivate
every learner.

all_classified.company_summary: Resolution is a company that specializes in claims management and risk pooling services for the National Health Service (NHS) in the UK. It offers a range of clinical and non-clinical indemnity schemes, including support for healthcare practitioners and organizations, as well as guidance on dispute resolution and practitioner performance. The company primarily serves NHS trusts and healthcare professionals, ensuring comprehensive support and resources in managing claims and mitigating risks.

# Welcome

NHS Resolution is an arm’s-length body of the Department of Health and Social Care. We provide
expertise to the NHS on resolving concerns and disputes fairly, sharing learning for improvement and
preserving resources for patient care.

[Find out more][155]

## [Maternity Incentive Scheme Year 8 Guidance][156]

A transitional year for the scheme

Read more

## [Receive our newsletter Resolution Matters][157]

Sign up to receive our corporate newsletter Resolution Matters

Read more

## [Our 2025-28 strategy is now live][159]

Read more

* [Claims Management][160]
  
  Delivers expertise in handling both clinical and non-clinical claims through our indemnity
  schemes.
* [Practitioner Performance Advice][161]
  
  Delivers expert advice, support and interventions on the fair management of concerns about the
  performance of doctors, dentists and pharmacists.
* [Primary Care Appeals][162]
  
  Offers an impartial resolution service for the fair handling of primary care contracting disputes.
* [Safety and Learning][163]
  
  Supports the NHS, our members and beneficiaries to better understand their claims risk profiles,
  to target their safety activity while sharing learning across the system to improve patient care.

### Our services and key information
* [Advice for claimants][168] Includes information on who can claim and how
* [Clinical Negligence Scheme for Trusts][169] Indemnity arrangements for NHS trusts and independent
  bodies that provide healthcare
* [Coronavirus indemnity arrangements][170] Includes information on schemes, vaccinations and
  designated care settings arrangements to support the response
* [Early Notification Scheme][171] Includes information and support on how the initiative works and
  is applied
* [General Practice Indemnity][172] Includes indemnity arrangements for primary care services
* [Healthcare Professional Alert Notices][173] Carry out pre-employment checks on healthcare
  practitioners
* [Maternity Incentive Scheme][174] Includes information on the six safety actions and how they need
  to be met
* [Practitioner Performance Advice][175] Access to advice, assessment, intervention and training
  services

# **MADE FOR MOBILITY**

INNOVATIVE | DATA-DRIVEN | PREVENTION

## Award-Winning Technology

## Our Products

At Recovery Force Health, our mission is to be a leader in providing innovative devices and digital
health solutions that alleviate unnecessary barriers for healthcare professionals in the hospital
and at home to improve patient outcomes.

## MAC™

The **world’s first** wearable therapeutic compression device that also measures and displays
real-time patient compliance (wear time) and mobility data.

[Learn more][18]

## ELEVATE™

Designed to effectively offload the sacrum and seamlessly contour the body to enhance patient
comfort and compliance.

[Learn more][19]

## HeelP.O.D.™

Effectively offloads or “floats” the foot and provides visual assurance of offloading with immersion
& envelopment technology.

[Learn more][20]

## Impacting Patients – *It’s in our DNA*

## Patients Impacted

## MAC Legs Served

# The Importance of Early Mobilization

Contrary to popular thought processes, mobility is more than just ambulating. Mobilization can also
mean periodic changes in position, such as turning the patient, sitting in bed, dangling at the side
of the bed, getting to the chair, and ambulation.

Studies have shown that implementing **early progressive mobilization** is associated with improved
functional outcomes, reduced hospital costs, and decreased length of stay.

Since 2018, we’ve collaborated with Mayo Clinic to develop a novel mechanism for enhancing blood
flow and optimizing clinical workflow.

[Learn more][21]

# Development of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a clinical stage biotech company based in Sweden,
dedicated to advancing the field of cutting-edge RNA therapeutics. Our mission is to establish a
world-leading company in RNA research and development, ultimately making a positive impact on
patients worldwide.

[ Learn more ][23]
[ Partnering opportunities ][24]

### About Ribocure

Ribocure has established an exceptional setup known as “from bench-to-bed” on the fifth and sixth
floor in the GoCo Clinic building. This setup encompasses an R&D department, an in vitro human cell
lab, and the Ribocure Clinic which serves as a specialized unit for Phase 2 clinical trials.

The Ribocure Clinic is dedicated to ensuring top-notch quality in conducting proof-of-principle and
concept trials within our expertise areas, while also featuring a functional imaging core lab
capacity.

[ Read more ][25]
[Ribocure]

### Partnering opportunities

Ribocure is open to partnering opportunities. If you think there are prerequisites for a fruitful
collaboration, please contact our Vice President of Business Development for a discussion.

John Taylor, VP Business Development

[john.taylor@ribocure.com][26]

[career opportunities]

## Oligonucleotide therapeutics for your wellbeing

Ribocure’s main emphasis lies in addressing the significant unmet medical requirements in rare
diseases associated with cardiovascular, renal, and oncology therapeutic areas. The company is fully
committed to the exploration and advancement of first- and best-in-class drug assets, aiming to
pioneer the development of groundbreaking treatments using innovative oligonucleotide technologies.
As a subsidiary of Ribo Life Science Co., Ltd., Ribocure leverages the advantages of a vertically
integrated oligonucleotide research platform while incorporating their exceptional translational and
clinical operational expertise within the organization.

[ Read more ][27]

### Building a world-leading company in Sweden

Ribocure Pharmaceuticals AB (Ribocure) is a newly established Swedish biotech company that
specializes in the cutting-edge development of RNA therapeutics. We aspire to forge a world-leading
company in RNA therapeutics research and development here in Sweden, with the aim of making a
positive impact on patients across the globe.

[ Read more ][28]
