Therapeutic Ultrasound-Based Solution for Vascular Care

Venous thromboembolism (VTE) consists of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and pulmonary embolism (PE) and represents a significant clinical challenge.

3rd Leading
cardiovascular disease is VTE. ¹

300,000 Deaths
in the U.S. are caused by VTEs each year. ²

Up to 50% of patients with DVT
will develop long-term complications, including post-thrombotic syndrome (PTS). ³

Our Solutions

# Global CRO Specializing in [Dermatology][73], [Internal Medicine][74], [Neuroscience][75],
# [Oncology][76], and [Ophthalmology][77]

TFS HealthScience supports biotech and pharmaceutical companies with tailored clinical development
and resource solutions. We combine the full-service capabilities and global reach of a large
contract research organization with the flexibility and personal approach only a mid-size CRO can
deliver. With TFS you get a shared commitment to your success. Expect more.

### Clinical Development

Scientific and operational experts tailor solutions to meet the needs of your project from
regulatory strategy and clinical operations phases I-III to post-authorization and real-world
evidence studies.

Read More

### Resourcing Solutions

Insource a single critical need to a fully managed team. Our flexible staffing and recruitment
services provide high-quality performance, expertise, and dedication to bringing your products to
market faster.

Read More

### Functional Services (FSP)

From global end-to-end clinical development to a single service, we create fit-for-purpose FSP
outsourcing models that approach your clinical workforce management efficiently and
cost-effectively.

Read More

[dermatology cro services]

## Transforming Clinical Trials with Innovative Study Solutions

## Real World Evidence

We help bridge the gap between clinical trials and clinical practice by delivering quality evidence
and reliable outcomes. TFS has pragmatic Phase IV trials across a broad range of indications at over
more than 20 years of experience designing and running global non-interventional studies (NIS) at
nearly 7,000 sites worldwide.

[Read more][98]

## Virtual Studies:
## Decentralized study solutions to reach participants where they are and keep your study on track

No industry is immune to the effects of the COVID-19 global pandemic. The clinical trials industry
has witnessed increasing acceptance of virtual data and communication technologies by physicians,
patients, ethics committees, regulatory agencies, and sponsors. TFS has expertise managing large
global clinical studies using the latest technologies all integrated through our digital platform to
reach patients where they are. For 25 years our customers have trusted us with their clinical
development programs, and now more than ever, we are prepared to offer tailored solutions to meet
customer challenges, no matter the size.

[Read more][99]

## Expert & Talent Solutions

With more than 25 years of experience in the Health Science industry customers turn to us as their
first choice when looking for advisory or project support. Our network of key opinion leaders,
subject matter experts and industry leading talent is available to help with critical business
decisions and the delivery of key project milestones.

## About Us

### TFS HealthScience is a global CRO (Contract Research Organization) that partners with
### biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development process.

In partnership, we build solution-driven teams of experienced professionals working together for a
healthier future. TFS provides scientific expertise and a full scope of services and resourcing
solutions to allow you to stay focused on health innovations. Explore how our solutions can help
drive your clinical research.

[More about us][101]

## Global CRO Careers

Motivated by results and driven by passion for great work, we are a team with a common goal: to
bring treatments to patients faster. What we do thrills us and we’re looking for amazing people to
join our team. [Find your place with us.][102]

[Open Positions][103]

## CRO Insights on Clinical Research

As a top global contract research organization, we stay ahead of emerging trends and innovations to
drive more efficient, patient-centric clinical trials. Our experts analyze shifting regulatory
landscapes, evolving trial methodologies, and breakthrough technologies to help biotech and
pharmaceutical partners navigate the complexities of modern clinical research. Explore our latest
thought leadership content to stay informed on the advancements shaping the future of clinical
development.

# A new way to treat varicose veins

Heaviness. Aching. Itching. Living with varicose veins can be difficult, both physically and
emotionally. But treatment doesn’t have to be. 

 

Explore Varithena

[Benefits of Varithena][21][Patient experience][22][Common vein
problems][23][Treatment][24][FAQ][25][Physician finder][26]

## Get back to living with Varithena

When it comes to treating varicose veins and getting back to the activities you love, there’s a new,
nearly painless way. Varithena is a gentle microfoam treatment delivered in as few as 1-2 needle
sticks. Patients reporting pain at the injection or application site in clinical trials was
4.0%.¹ For most people, Varithena improves both physical symptoms related to varicose veins, and
their appearance.

This fast, minimally invasive treatment allows you to do something about your varicose veins your
way—with little to no downtime. Please note that you should not be treated with Varithena if you’re
allergic to polidocanol or have clots in your blood vessels.

[ Learn the benefits of the Varithena treatment ][27]
[Back of legs showing before and after Varithena treatment.]

In this short video, a patient shares how the pain and appearance of his varicose veins improved
after receiving treatment with Varithena.

With all medical procedures there are risks associated with the implant procedure and the use of the
device. Be sure to talk with your doctor so that you thoroughly understand all of the risks and

might be available to you.

They can talk to you about what’s right for you.

### Treatment & results

Thousands of people who want to feel and look their best choose Varithena. It’s covered by most

their days. Learn what happens during and after the procedure and see before-and-after photos.

### Frequently asked questions

[Get answers][35]

**References**
1. Data on file

**Indications**

Varithena (polidocanol injectable foam) 1% is a prescription medicine used to treat varicose veins
caused by problems with the great saphenous vein (GSV) and other related veins in the leg's GSV
system. Varithena improves symptoms related to or caused by varicose veins, and the appearance of
varicose veins.

**Important safety information**

You should not be treated with Varithena if you are allergic to polidocanol or have clots in your
blood vessels. Severe allergic reactions have been reported in people treated with liquid forms of
polidocanol and some patients have died from these reactions. Varithena is a foam made from
polidocanol. A healthcare professional will observe you for signs of allergic reactions for at least
10 minutes after you are treated with Varithena. Tell your doctor about all your medical conditions,
including if you have:
* Arterial disease (a disease of the blood vessels)
* Reduced mobility
* A history of blood clots in the veins or lungs
* Had major surgery in the past 3 months
* Recently had a long hospital stay
* Become pregnant or were recently pregnant

The most common side effects seen with Varithena are leg pain or discomfort, injection site bruising
or pain, and potentially serious blood clots in the leg veins. These are not all the possible side
effects of Varithena. Tell your healthcare provider about any side effect that bothers you or that
does not go away. You can also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. Varithena is
administered by your doctor. Doctors using Varithena must be experienced in vein procedures and
trained in using Varithena.

### Treatment & results

Thousands of people who want to feel and look their best choose Varithena. It’s covered by most

**References**
1. Data on file

**Indications**

Varithena (polidocanol injectable foam) 1% is a prescription medicine used to treat varicose veins
caused by problems with the great saphenous vein (GSV) and other related veins in the leg's GSV
system. Varithena improves symptoms related to or caused by varicose veins, and the appearance of
varicose veins.

**Important safety information**

You should not be treated with Varithena if you are allergic to polidocanol or have clots in your
blood vessels. Severe allergic reactions have been reported in people treated with liquid forms of
polidocanol and some patients have died from these reactions. Varithena is a foam made from
polidocanol. A healthcare professional will observe you for signs of allergic reactions for at least
10 minutes after you are treated with Varithena. Tell your doctor about all your medical conditions,
including if you have:
* Arterial disease (a disease of the blood vessels)
* Reduced mobility
* A history of blood clots in the veins or lungs
* Had major surgery in the past 3 months
* Recently had a long hospital stay
* Become pregnant or were recently pregnant

The most common side effects seen with Varithena are leg pain or discomfort, injection site bruising
or pain, and potentially serious blood clots in the leg veins. These are not all the possible side
effects of Varithena. Tell your healthcare provider about any side effect that bothers you or that
does not go away. You can also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. Varithena is
administered by your doctor. Doctors using Varithena must be experienced in vein procedures and
trained in using Varithena.

# About Us

**Vegas Vascular Specialists** is the largest vascular surgery group in Las Vegas, trusted for
delivering exceptional vascular care. Our mission is to provide compassionate, cutting-edge
supervision through the advanced diagnosis and treatment of complex conditions, restoring your
**health and quality of life**. We incorporate a patient-first philosophy, led by a team of highly
experienced specialists who utilize **state-of-the-art technology** to provide exceptional outcomes.
With over **20 years of service** to the Las Vegas community, Vegas Vascular Specialists continue to
uphold a legacy of **excellence, innovation, and trust** in every procedure we perform.

[Eddy H. Luh, MD, FSVS, RPVI, FACS]

## What Makes Us The Most Trusted Vascular Health Specialists?

[Vascular Conditions Treated]

### Comprehensive Range of Vascular Conditions Treated

We specialize in diagnosing and treating a wide range of vascular disorders with precision and care.
Be it peripheral artery disease (PAD), carotid artery disease, deep vein thrombosis (DVT), or
varicose veins. Our multidisciplinary approach ensures that every condition is managed using the
most effective and minimally invasive solutions available today.

[expert team]

### Expert Team of Board-Certified Vascular Specialists

Our team comprises board-certified vascular and endovascular surgeons with extensive expertise in
complex vascular procedures. Led by highly respected providers such as Dr. Eddy H Luh, our
specialists bring decades of clinical excellence and innovation to every patient case, guaranteeing
you the highest standards of vascular care in Nevada. As a team of leading **vein doctors in Las
Vegas**, we are dedicated to delivering personalized treatments that combine advanced techniques
with compassionate care to achieve the best possible outcomes.

[health insurance range]

### Wide Range of Accepted Insurance Plans

To make quality vascular care accessible to all, our **vein specialist Las Vegas** team partners
with major insurance providers, including Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield (all product lines
EXCEPT Pathway HMO), Cigna, Medicare, Medicaid, UnitedHealthcare, and many others. Our commitment to
affordability and accessibility ensures that patients can receive the best vascular treatments
without compromise.

[Leading Medical]

### Featured On Leading Medical and Local Platforms

Vegas Vascular Specialists have been featured on multiple healthcare and media platforms, such as
Nevada Business Magazine, FindHealthCareUSA, The Valley Health System, Las Vegas HEALS, and Vegas
Golden Knights. These features reflect our reputation as innovators in the field, recognized not
only by patients but also by the broader medical community for our exceptional contributions.

## Our Achievements and Recognition

### Prestigious Awards and Honors

We are proud recipients of prestigious awards that reflect our commitment to excellence in vascular
care:
* **2025 Nevada’s Thoracoabdominal Branched Endoprosthesis (TAMBE) – **Featured by [8 News Now][61]
following the successful completion of Nevada’s first FDA-approved minimally invasive repair for
complex aortic aneurysms. This historic milestone highlights major advancements in advanced
vascular surgery, expanded treatment options, and improved recovery outcomes for patients across
Southern Nevada.
* **2025 Excellence in Community Practice Award** – Presented by the Society for Vascular Surgery
(SVS) to Dr. Eddy Luh, MD, the distinguished [vascular surgeon in Las Vegas][62], whom patients
trust, recognizing his leadership and contributions to advancing community vascular health.****
* **Top Vascular Care Services Provider 2024** – Awarded by Healthcare Business Review to [Vegas
Vascular Specialists][63] for delivering advanced, patient-centered vascular treatments.

### Milestones That Redefined Vascular Surgery in Nevada

Vegas Vascular Specialists have paved the way for modern vascular surgery in this town by:
* We performed the first-ever implanted thoracic branched endograft in the state, marking a major
breakthrough in minimally invasive aortic repair techniques.
* The first internal iliac branched endograft procedure in Nevada was successfully completed by us.
This expanded the treatment options for patients with complex pelvic artery aneurysms.
* By far, we have achieved the highest number of physician-modified endografts in the state,
exceeding others by a factor of ten. Our **vascular surgeons in Las Vegas** continue to lead the
way in complex endovascular reconstruction, ensuring the best outcomes for patients across the
state.
* We have also performed the first Transcarotid Arterial Revascularization (TCAR) in Nevada,
introducing a safer, less invasive solution for treating carotid artery disease.
* Alongside this, we completed the most TCAR procedures statewide, by a factor of ten, leading the
state with a record number of successful, life-saving interventions.
* Introduced the first percutaneous transluminal angioplasty and bypass (PTAB) procedure in Nevada,
expanding the scope of advanced endovascular treatment options for complex arterial conditions.
* The first “candy-plug”/TEVAR procedure for complicated thoracic aortic dissection in the state was
also done by us, setting a new benchmark for emergency vascular interventions.
* Implemented the first laser fenestration for PMEG AAA in Nevada, providing a tailored and highly
effective solution for complex abdominal aortic aneurysms.
* We have also led the way with the first IVC and iliac vein recanalization in the state, restoring
proper blood flow and helping patients recover from severe vein blockages that restricted
circulation.

## Our Achievements and Recognition

### Prestigious Awards and Honors

We are proud recipients of prestigious awards that reflect our commitment to excellence in vascular
care:
* **2025 Nevada’s Thoracoabdominal Branched Endoprosthesis (TAMBE) – **Featured by [8 News Now][61]
following the successful completion of Nevada’s first FDA-approved minimally invasive repair for
complex aortic aneurysms. This historic milestone highlights major advancements in advanced
vascular surgery, expanded treatment options, and improved recovery outcomes for patients across
Southern Nevada.
* **2025 Excellence in Community Practice Award** – Presented by the Society for Vascular Surgery
(SVS) to Dr. Eddy Luh, MD, the distinguished [vascular surgeon in Las Vegas][62], whom patients
trust, recognizing his leadership and contributions to advancing community vascular health.****
* **Top Vascular Care Services Provider 2024** – Awarded by Healthcare Business Review to [Vegas
Vascular Specialists][63] for delivering advanced, patient-centered vascular treatments.

### Milestones That Redefined Vascular Surgery in Nevada

Vegas Vascular Specialists have paved the way for modern vascular surgery in this town by:
* We performed the first-ever implanted thoracic branched endograft in the state, marking a major
breakthrough in minimally invasive aortic repair techniques.
* The first internal iliac branched endograft procedure in Nevada was successfully completed by us.
This expanded the treatment options for patients with complex pelvic artery aneurysms.
* By far, we have achieved the highest number of physician-modified endografts in the state,
exceeding others by a factor of ten. Our **vascular surgeons in Las Vegas** continue to lead the
way in complex endovascular reconstruction, ensuring the best outcomes for patients across the
state.
* We have also performed the first Transcarotid Arterial Revascularization (TCAR) in Nevada,
introducing a safer, less invasive solution for treating carotid artery disease.
* Alongside this, we completed the most TCAR procedures statewide, by a factor of ten, leading the
state with a record number of successful, life-saving interventions.
* Introduced the first percutaneous transluminal angioplasty and bypass (PTAB) procedure in Nevada,
expanding the scope of advanced endovascular treatment options for complex arterial conditions.
* The first “candy-plug”/TEVAR procedure for complicated thoracic aortic dissection in the state was
also done by us, setting a new benchmark for emergency vascular interventions.
* Implemented the first laser fenestration for PMEG AAA in Nevada, providing a tailored and highly
effective solution for complex abdominal aortic aneurysms.
* We have also led the way with the first IVC and iliac vein recanalization in the state, restoring
proper blood flow and helping patients recover from severe vein blockages that restricted
circulation.

## Our mission is to help you make the best choices for your health.

Welcome to Verywell Health, an award-winning resource for credible, fact-based, and up-to-date
information you need to confidently make health choices for yourself and your loved ones.

We are dedicated to empowering you with the best answers to your most pressing questions, from
understanding infectious diseases to managing a new diagnosis and everything in between.

For more than 20 years, we’ve worked to create and refine our curated library of comprehensive and
trustworthy information. Our team of writers and editors are industry experts and health journalists
who create and update our 22,000+ article library, and research and report vital health and medical
news.

The Verywell Health Medical Expert Board of board-certified physicians vets our articles and join us
in our mission to make you confident in your next steps to better health.

## Meet Our Medical Expert Board

Our team of more than 150 experienced medical professionals join us in our mission to empower you to
confidently take the next steps in your health journey—for yourself or a loved one. They ensure our
content is medically accurate and reflects the latest in evidence-based research and health
information.

The [Medical Expert Board][41] of board-certified physicians represents 30+ specialties. Here are a
few of our members:

### Anisha Shah, MD

Anisha Shah, MD, is a board-certified internist, interventional cardiologist, and a fellow of the

## FAQ

What's in Start?+

10 lab uploads, one base Yasnost report, intake check-up packs, one-link sharing. Enough to get a
first read on your health and decide whether a paid plan is worth it.

Plus vs Pro?+

Plus is for ongoing monitoring: 10 Yasnost reports a month, trend charts, a personalised lab pack.
Pro is for deep reads: unlimited base reports, 5 advanced reports a month, doctor-visit prep,
biological age, scans of medical letters and discharge summaries.

How do I cancel?+

One button in settings. Access stays until the end of the billed period. Auto-renew stops the moment
you click.

How is billing handled?+

Monthly charge to a saved card via YooKassa. A receipt is emailed under Russian Federal Law 54-FZ
right after payment. If a card is declined, we give you 3 days to update before access pauses.

Can I switch plans?+

Yes. Upgrade kicks in immediately and the unused portion of the current plan rolls over. Downgrade
takes effect from the next period — current plan stays active until then.

Pro is for deep reads: unlimited base reports, 5 advanced reports a month, doctor-visit prep,

One button in settings. Access stays until the end of the billed period. Auto-renew stops the moment

Monthly charge to a saved card via YooKassa. A receipt is emailed under Russian Federal Law 54-FZ
right after payment. If a card is declined, we give you 3 days to update before access pauses.

takes effect from the next period — current plan stays active until then.
